We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview
The Designer IV - Mapper serves as a senior technical lead responsible for the development, maintenance, quality control, and delivery of mapping and geospatial design products that support pipeline engineering, permitting, construction, operations, integrity management, and regulatory compliance activities. This position provides advanced mapping expertise and leadership for complex pipeline and facility projects, utilizing GIS, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and other geospatial technologies to develop accurate, high-quality mapping deliverables.

The Designer IV - Mapper is responsible for coordinating mapping and spatial data activities across multiple projects, ensuring the integrity of geospatial data, and supporting multidisciplinary teams with routing studies, alignment development, environmental constraints mapping, exhibit preparation, land and right-of-way mapping, and construction support documentation. The role requires extensive knowledge of pipeline design standards, mapping principles, spatial analysis, and data management practices.

Working closely with engineers, surveyors, project managers, environmental specialists, permitting teams, and clients, the Designer IV - Mapping develops mapping solutions that support project planning and execution while ensuring compliance with company standards, regulatory requirements, and client specifications. This position also serves as a mentor to junior mapping personnel, provides technical guidance on GIS and mapping best practices, and helps establish quality assurance procedures for geospatial deliverables.

The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise in mapping and geospatial systems, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex projects while delivering accurate, reliable, and visually effective mapping products that support critical business and project objectives.

Responsibilities

Lead and oversee all aspects of pipeline design projects from concept development through final deliverables.

Develop and implement effective design strategies to support project objectives, schedules, and client requirements.

Review vendor-supplied data for accuracy and integrate applicable information into project design development.

Direct the preparation, drafting, maintenance, and revision of pipeline design documents and drawing packages.

Review, check, and approve AutoCAD and Civil 3D drawings produced by design staff for quality, accuracy, and constructability.

Perform technical reviews of engineering and design deliverables to ensure compliance with company standards, client specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Lead the design and execution of complex pipeline facilities and crossings, including Horizontal Directional Drills (HDDs), railroad crossings, highway crossings, and other specialized installations.

Support engineering teams in the selection and specification of materials, equipment, and construction components commonly used in pipeline projects.

Coordinate design activities with engineering, surveying, environmental, permitting, right-of-way, and other disciplines to ensure successful project execution.

Interface with project engineers, project managers, clients, contractors, and regulatory stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Facilitate client meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions to communicate project progress and resolve design challenges.

Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while maintaining quality, schedule, and budget objectives.

Ensure all designs are developed in accordance with applicable safety requirements, industry codes, standards, and company procedures.

Provide leadership, supervision, mentoring, and technical guidance to junior designers and design staff.

Establish quality control processes and perform final design reviews prior to project issuance.

Identify design risks, recommend practical solutions, and support continuous improvement initiatives within the pipeline design group.

Serve as the technical lead for pipeline design activities and provide subject matter expertise for complex routing and facility design challenges.

Qualifications

Associate’s Degree, Technical Diploma, or Certificate in Computer-Aided Drafting (CAD), Drafting Technology, Design Technology, or a related field from an accredited college, university, or vocational institution. Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and relevant work experience may be considered.

Minimum of fifteen (15) years of experience utilizing AutoCAD for pipeline engineering and design projects.

Demonstrated experience supporting the design and development of natural gas, liquids, and/or transmission pipeline facilities and systems.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS applications, and Microsoft Office software, including Excel, Word, and Teams.

Strong understanding of pipeline design principles, industry drafting practices, and drawing production standards.

Experience reviewing and approving design drawings, alignment sheets, crossing drawings, permit drawings, and construction deliverables.

Thorough knowledge of applicable industry codes, regulations, standards, and best practices governing pipeline and gas utility design.

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, schematics, construction documents, and vendor-supplied data.

Advanced knowledge of pipeline routing, crossings, constructability considerations, and right-of-way constraints.

Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail and quality.

Ability to identify design conflicts, evaluate alternatives, and develop practical engineering solutions.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with clients, engineers, project managers, regulatory agencies, and contractors.

Proven leadership skills with the ability to supervise, mentor, and develop junior designers and drafting personnel.

Ability to prioritize workloads, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and consistently meet project schedules and deadlines.

Ability to work effectively both independently and within a multidisciplinary team environment.

Strong organizational and project coordination skills with a commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Experience leading pipeline design teams and managing complex pipeline projects.

Experience with Horizontal Directional Drill (HDD) design, railroad crossings, highway crossings, utility crossings, and permitting support.

Familiarity with natural gas transmission, gathering, distribution, and midstream facility design.

Experience coordinating with survey, environmental, permitting, integrity, and construction teams throughout the project lifecycle.

Working knowledge of client-specific standards and industry requirements for major energy operators and utility companies.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About us:

LayerZero Power Systems, Inc. is a leader in power management products for mission and process critical business applications. Our customer base is comprised of companies in the transaction processing, financial, computer service provision and semiconductor manufacture sectors. LayerZero provides innovative products to ensure ultimately high uptime of computers, servers, routers, communication equipment and other critical equipment. LayerZero manufactures “Best in Class” Eproducts representing high-end industrial solutions. LayerZero Power Systems is on a trajectory of sustained, high double-digit growth, with a loyal base of existing Fortune 100 customers and an expanding portfolio of new customers. To meet the challenge of growth and opportunities, LayerZero Power Systems is seeking additional Software Engineers to join the engineering team.


PURPOSE & RESPONSIBILITIES

The successful candidate will have direct responsibility for new product development projects and the processes that bring them to fruition. A Senior Software Engineer takes ownership of the full software life cycle from concept capture through end-of-life deprecation. Planning and process monitoring throughout the software life cycle are integral to the position’s responsibilities, as are specification, coding, testing and QA/QC of product. In addition to product development, a successful Senior Software Engineer acts as a role model and mentor for junior-level engineers, helping in guiding both their day-to-day contributions and their professional growth.


Embedded real-time software systems, communications, embedded databases, and human interfaces are all aspects of LayerZero’s core competency in software engineering. The successful candidate will be responsible for contributing to this broad range of software engineering disciplines. Excellence in customer communication is paramount to success in this role.


PRIMARY DUTIES:


  • Work with customers, both within LayerZero and end users, to define and capture requirements.
  • Develop software system architectures to realize complex requirements.
  • Use state of the art software techniques to design applications for new products.
  • Take ownership of and maintain existing software subsystems.
  • Directly contribute to the addition of new features and bug fixes to new and existing systems.
  • Develop in-depth understanding of complex SoC, DSP, FPGA, and similar components.
  • Partition large development efforts into manageable projects that can be delegated to other software engineers.
  • Develop testing strategies for complex, configurable applications.
  • Manage product life-cycle trajectory.
  • Participate in software code reviews via on-line tools.
  • Enhance the new product development process.
  • Mentor junior-level engineers.


Requirements

EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & EDUCATION:


  • Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Master of Science in Computer Engineering, Master of Science in Computer Science, or Ph.D. in the above disciplines
  • A minimum of 10 years of success in full software lifecycle development from concept capture through end-of-life
  • In-depth knowledge of C/C++ programming

  • In-depth knowledge of database tools such as MySQL.
  • Working knowledge of web interface tools such as PHP, JavaScript, etc. .
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages, e.g., Python, Bash, etc.
  • Practical skill in design and construction of useful, real-world items
  • Hands-on experience in embedded real-time software development with embedded Linux or other embedded OS.
  • Success with integrated hardware/software co-design.
  • Experience with embedded Linux build frameworks such as Yocto or Buildroot
  • Experience with TCP/IP networking and industrial data communication protocols such as MODBUS/TCP, BACnet, and SNMP
  • Expertise with project management and defect management tools
  • Experience with Windows and Linux application development


Why Join Us? Our Benefits Make a Difference.

We believe great employees deserve great benefits designed to support health, financial well-being, professional growth, and family needs. Most of our core benefits are provided at no cost, reflecting our commitment to investing in the well-being of our team.

Why You Will Love Working with Us

  • Collaborative Spirit: Work closely with engineers, marketers, and other professionals to bring ideas to life.

title: Program Director IW Women's Center
description:
Title: Program Director

Reports to: Deputy Director of Emergency Shelter

Employment Status: Full-time

FSLA Status: Exempt

Pay rate: $75,000-$85,000 annual

POSITION SUMMARY

The Interfaith Works Women's Center at Taft Court (IWWC-2Taft) is an emergency shelter serving adult women experiencing homelessness. The program provides shelter, meals, and case management services with a housing focus. The goal of the program is to quickly move shelter clients to housing so that homelessness is rare, brief, and non-recurring. The Program Director oversees all program activities and provides direct supervision to the Program Support Manager, the Housing Services Coordinator, the Peer Support Specialist, the Community Engagement and Volunteer Coordinator, and Social Work Interns. In addition, the Program Director acts as the liaison to the Department of Health and Human Services for any onsite issues.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide a supportive work environment to the team focused on training, coaching, and development; encourage a strength-based approach to providing services; and focus on providing best practices including harm reduction and trauma-informed care.
  • Supervise the Program Support Manager (PSM) to ensure the building is functioning properly and that the appropriate parties are informed of concerns.
  • Work with the PSM to ensure schedules for Program Support Staff are completed and staff are receiving appropriate supervision.
  • Read all daily log notes, participate in log communication by writing notes and responding to comments, and provide guidance with email follow up when necessary.
  • Supervise the Community Engagement and Volunteer Coordinator to ensure donations are logged appropriately, volunteers are entered and maintained in the volunteer database, and that there is appropriate coordination for large volunteer events and regular tours.
  • Facilitate or assist with program tours.
  • Work together with the Community Engagement and Volunteer Coordinator to ensure meal volunteers are scheduled for all meals.
  • Help Community Engagement and Volunteer Coordinator recruit and build and maintain relationships with volunteers.
  • Supervise and work with the Inventory Specialist/Data Entry to ensure shelter is well stocked with supplies and appropriate data is collected and tracked in a timely manner. Collaborate with writing reports for the County and local municipalities. Ensure Satisfaction Surveys are completed quarterly.
  • Supervise Housing Services Coordinator so connections and housing opportunities are being created with landlords and property managers on behalf of shelter clients, and housing-related groups are conducted at the shelter to meet County contract goals.
  • Supervise Peer Support Specialist to ensure that clients identify safe and appropriate housing options (other than the street/car/shelter) to help them achieve a rapid return to housing and avoid a longer-term experience of homelessness.
  • Facilitate and create an agenda for the weekly staff meetings and ensure adherence to the IW policies and procedures so staff are compliant with daily program procedures.
  • Attend bi-weekly group supervision meetings with Program Support Manager and Program Support Staff to provide coaching and guidance regarding any shelter related concerns.
  • Review referrals to ensure compliance with eligibility requirements.
  • Attend Community Meetings and meet with clients as needed and/or if they are non-compliant with program expectations.
  • Ensure all staff attend mandatory trainings as required by the County Contract and Interfaith Works.
  • Provide supervision to Social Work student interns, completing all necessary documents as required by the Universities.
  • Work with the HR Department to interview and select candidates for shelter positions; provide onboarding and training to staff and interns, as appropriate.
  • Maintain compliance with County Contract expectations and report on outcome measures as outlined by the contract and IW; ensure compliance with mandatory reporting laws, incident reporting, ethical guidelines, and other compliance items as required.
  • Provide performance feedback as needed and complete annual written performance evaluations to supervisees.
  • Utilize the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) to collect pertinent stats, and prepare monthly, quarterly, and biannual reports as required by the County, other funders, or IW.
  • Review HMIS data entry weekly to ensure the clinical team is maintaining proper documentation.
  • Prepare for and participate in audits conducted by Montgomery County and as required by other funding sources.
  • Develop and maintain the IWWC budget, Community Grant Budget, Diversion Specialist budget and the Security program budget in coordination with the Finance Department and Deputy Director of Emergency Shelter Services.
  • Approve program expenditures and monitor program budget spend down, adjusting spending as needed and approve monthly program invoices to the County.
  • Code and sign billing invoices as needed.
  • Serve as a member of the IW Leadership Team and attend monthly Program Director meetings.
  • Participate in the biweekly Coordinated Entry System meetings regarding housing referrals and resources and join the County's Emergency Services and Outreach meeting on a monthly basis.
  • Attend Intensive Teaming Meetings and other interdisciplinary meetings as needed.
  • Complete biweekly timecard review and approval and monitor staff schedules.
  • Respond to all grievances and concerns in a timely manner; schedule grievance meetings with clients and provide written documentation as needed.
  • Perform other related tasks and duties as assigned by the Deputy Director of Emergency Shelter.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES)

  • A Master's in Social Work, Counseling, or similar behavioral health field.
  • A valid Licensed Certified Social Work – Clinical (LCSW-C) or License Clinical Professional Counselor (LCPC) Maryland license and three years post-graduate experience preferred.
  • Experience working with individuals with acute and chronic behavioral health issues and knowledge of crisis intervention techniques.
  • Knowledge and ability to effectively apply best practices in engaging those experiencing homelessness, including Trauma-Informed Care, Housing First, Harm Reduction and Motivational Interviewing.
  • Flexibility and openness to working in a fast-paced program serving clients from diverse racial, cultural and socio-economic backgrounds.
  • Availability to work at least one evening per week.
  • Availability to answer calls after hours.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work as a team member with compassion, respect and professionalism.
  • Knowledge of issues related to homelessness and community resources.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

BENEFITS

Interfaith Works offers a comprehensive benefits package for its employees. Employees receive 14 paid holidays and 21 days of PTO. Benefits for full-time employees, those who work 30 hours per week or more, include access to subsidized medical, dental, and vision costs for employees and their families; employer paid long-term disability insurance as well as life and AD&D insurance. Employees have the option to purchase supplemental benefits that are fully portable, including short-term disability insurance, critical illness insurance, and more. All employees regardless of full or part time status have access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost to them.

NOTE

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship.

TO APPLY

Interested candidates must submit a resume with their application to be considered. Applicants must apply through this link. Please send any questions about the application process to hr@iworksmc.org.

title: Research Project Coordinator
description:
**Department:** MED-Impact Institute

**Salary/Grade:** EXS/5

_Target hiring range for this position will be between $51,350 - $60,000 per year.  Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data._

**Job Summary:**

Manages daily operations of a biomedical &/or social-behavioral research study involving multidisciplinary teams of colleagues, sponsors & other external project stakeholders.  Monitors study performance, analyzes & review results, & supervises development & implementation of new protocols.  Assigns work & supervises study staff & reviews technical operations ensuring that all processes, protocols & procedures are quality controlled & functioning up to standards.  Develops implements & administers budgets, grant & administrative procedures.  May co-author scientific papers for presentation & publication & coordinates writing, submission & administration of grants.  Ensures that all study activities are completed by strictly following Good Clinical Practices (GCP) & all current local, state, & federal laws, regulations, guidance, policy & procedure developed by the NU Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food & Drug Administration (FDA) Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), & the International Conference on Harmonization (ICH).

_Position Responsibilities_

The Biomedical Project Coordinator’s primary responsibilities include providing expanded biomedical operational support and laboratory coverage for the RADAR study across its research locations at Center on Halsted and 625 N. Michigan Avenue, as well as the planned mobile research unit. Working collaboratively with the existing Biomedical Coordinator, this position will help coordinate biomedical staffing, participant visit coverage, and laboratory operations to accommodate increasing study enrollment and participant visit volume. Both positions report directly to the Project Director and work closely with the Interview Coordinator, Recruitment and Retention Coordinator, and study faculty.

This position ensures that biomedical components of study visits are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory standards. Specific responsibilities include performing phlebotomy, HIV/STI counseling and testing, and biospecimen collection and processing; coordinating specimen storage and transportation; maintaining laboratory safety and documentation; managing laboratory inventory and equipment; ensuring data accuracy and specimen integrity; and maintaining compliance with institutional and federal guidelines. The Biomedical Project Coordinator will also provide direct participant-facing biomedical services and assist with cross-site staffing coverage to ensure continuity of operations during staff absences and periods of increased visit demand.

The Biomedical Project Coordinator will take a lead role in developing and implementing biomedical operations for RADAR's planned mobile research unit, including field-based specimen collection and processing procedures, equipment and supply management, specimen transportation, and laboratory safety protocols. In collaboration with the existing Biomedical Coordinator, the position will support staff training and competency assessments, develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), implement quality assurance measures, and coordinate biomedical workflows across research locations to ensure consistent, participant-centered, high-quality research operations.

- The Biomedical Project Coordinator is expected to work evening hours (e.g., 11 AM – 7 PM) and weekend shifts to accommodate participant scheduling, mobile unit deployment, and study retention needs.
- This position requires regular on-site presence and flexibility to work across RADAR's research locations, including the mobile research unit.
- We are seeking a diverse pool of candidates. Candidates from backgrounds traditionally underrepresented in research are strongly encouraged to apply.

_Please note:_

Supervisor provides objectives, deadlines and specific instructions only for new, difficult, and/or unusual work.  Work is reviewed upon completion and only occasionally to verify technical accuracy and compliance with practice, policy, and procedures.  EE informs supervisor of on-going progress and/or potentially controversial matters.

_Work Location Requirement_

As this role supports an in-person research study, full-time on-site presence is required. Direct coordination with participants, staff, and study resources must occur on campus to ensure the integrity of study operations and participant engagement. Remote, hybrid, or work-from-home arrangements are not possible for this position.

_Driver’s License Requirement_

Because this position involves the use of a mobile unit to conduct research study visits, applicants must hold a valid driver’s license and meet the eligibility criteria of the University’s Safe Driver Program. This includes following all program guidelines regarding responsibilities, safe driving practices, and authorization for vehicle use on University business.

**Specific Responsibilities**:

_Technical_

- Leads execution & control of a biomedical &/or social science project or research study.
- Coordinates processing & analysis of data, conduct of experimental tests & procedures
- Develops new &/or revised research methodologies.
- Ensures completion of study activities per protocol including recruitment.
- Ascertains pretreatment & eligibility requirements.
- Obtains informed consent.
- Registers participant with appropriate sponsor.
- Interviews & obtains medical & social histories.
- Collects data from medical records.
- Administers, schedules &/or scores tests.

_Administration_

- Oversees & manages collection, maintenance, analysis & evaluation of data that will be used in grant submissions, presentations & publications.
- Ensures that information is entered correctly into databases.
- Assists PI in reviewing, analyzing, interpreting, summarizing, formatting, editing, & preparing tables, charts, graphs, progress & final reports, etc.
- Coordinates between sponsoring agencies, collaborating organizations &/or other research &/or educational institutions.
- Ensures that all study documents associated with current local, state, & federal regulatory guidelines, requirements, laws & research protocols are completed in a timely manner.

_Finance_

- Manages lab/study budget & inventory including purchasing of supplies & services ensuring that they are necessary, reasonable & project related.
- Orders & maintains inventory of study supplies.
- Distributes intra-departmental charges.
- Negotiates with vendors, obtain quotes & arrange for demos of large equipment.

_Supervision_

- Trains, directs, assigns duties to & supervises research staff, students, residents &/or fellows.
- Acts as a mentor in regard to education of junior coordinators.

_Miscellaneous_

Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in a major such as social or health science or related; OR appropriate combination of education and experience and 3 years' research study or other relevant experience required; OR
- Successful completion of a full course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a master's or higher degree in a major such as social or health science or related; OR appropriate combination of education and experience and 1 year research study or other relevant experience.
- Supervisory or project management experience required.
- Must complete NU's IRB CITI training before interacting with any participants & must re-certify every 3 years

**Minimum Competencies: (Skills, knowledge, and abilities.)**

- Phlebotomy certification and at least one year of direct experience performing venipuncture and specimen handling required.
- Demonstrated proficiency in biospecimen collection, labeling, processing, and storage, with attention to chain-of-custody and data integrity.
- Knowledge of universal precautions, bloodborne pathogen safety, and laboratory biosafety standards (BSL-2).
- Ability to maintain and troubleshoot laboratory equipment, including centrifuges, refrigerators/freezers, and specimen transport materials.
- Experience with HIV/STI testing workflows, rapid testing protocols, and linkage-to-care processes.
- Strong documentation and quality assurance skills, with ability to follow and enforce SOPs.
- Effective interpersonal communication skills for working with participants in sensitive biomedical contexts.
- Ability to train and monitor staff in specimen collection and safety procedures.
- Proficiency with laboratory tracking and data management tools (e.g., REDCap, Excel, or LIMS).
- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, participant-centered research environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Certification in HIV counseling and testing in Illinois.
- Experience managing or coordinating a biomedical research laboratory or clinical collection site.
- Experience supervising or mentoring biomedical research staff.
- Experience with MedSpeed or other specimen transport and logistics systems.
- Experience working directly with LGBTQ and/or HIV-positive participants in research or clinical settings.
- Experience developing SOPs or QA/QC systems for specimen collection and laboratory workflows.
- Familiarity with Northwestern University’s research and compliance systems (IRB, ASRSP, OSP).

**Preferred Competencies: (Skills, knowledge, and abilities)**

- Knowledge of Chicago communities, neighborhoods, and local public health resources.
- Familiarity with biomedical best practices for specimen integrity, temperature control, and documentation.
- Ability to develop training materials and lead laboratory safety and compliance trainings.
- Knowledge of sexual health and HIV prevention, particularly among sexual and gender minority populations.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team

_**Benefits:**_

The available benefits package for this position will include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid vacation and holidays; paid medical/sick and parentalleave;tuition benefits for the employee and dependents; pre-tax and flex spending accounts for commuting and dependent care; generous retirement savings options; and wellness programs. For a comprehensive overview of available benefits, including eligibility details, visit us at https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/benefits/index.html to learn more._

Visit us at_[_https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/benefits/work-life/index.html_](https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/benefits/work-life/index.html) _to learn more._

Any offer of employment with the BBC is conditional upon the candidate having the legal right to work in Nigeria and having successfully completed the mandatory National Youth Service programme (NYSC) or holding a valid certificate of exemption.

### PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

BBC World Service is evolving its editorial team in Lagos while future-proofing its journalism to meet changing media consumption habits across sub-Saharan Africa.

BBC News Pidgin is one of the most trusted international news providers for audiences across West Africa and a highly engaged global diaspora. With a strong editorial heritage, the service is entering an exciting new phase: transforming into a video-led operation designed to reach a new generation of Pidgin audiences who primarily consume news via smartphones and social media.

BBC News Pidgin is changing into a story-led model built around two complementary editorial streams: On the Day and On Demand.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

The Journalist is the core production resource of both streams. Whether working a morning or afternoon shift within On the Day or contributing to planned video and podcast production within On Demand, the Journalist is expected to move fluently between platforms, formats and roles (such as writing a web article, filming a clip, voicing a radio package and publishing a social post), often on the same story, within the same shift.

This transformation demands journalists who are not simply willing to work across platforms, but who think across platforms instinctively. That means asking, before production begins, how a story will serve audiences on the website, on Instagram, on TikTok and on radio or TV, and making deliberate choices about format, length and angle for each.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:

- Create and publish accurate, engaging and SEO-friendly news content for the BBC Pidgin website, ensuring timely updates and high editorial standards.
- Produce, present, shoot and edit short-form video content for platforms including TikTok, Instagram and Facebook, using strong storytelling and visual production skills.
- Develop compelling social media content that drives audience engagement, expands reach and supports content discovery across digital platforms.
- Respond quickly to breaking news, maintaining a consistent flow of content across the website and social channels throughout the day.
- Use audience analytics and performance insights to inform content decisions and continuously improve digital output.
- Contribute to BBC Pidgin’s visualised digital programming, presenting confidently on air and on screen for both broadcast and streaming audiences.
- Repurpose live digital and interview content into engaging digital clips, maximising audience reach across social media and the BBC Pidgin website.

### YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Proven experience creating engaging content across digital, social, radio and video platforms, with a strong understanding of audience needs and platform best practice.
- Excellent writing, reading, editing and storytelling skills in Pidgin, with the ability to produce accurate, engaging and SEO-aware content to tight deadlines.
- Strong video production skills, including presenting, self-shooting and editing content for platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels and Facebook – added advantage.
- Confident using audience analytics, headlines, thumbnails and metadata to optimise content performance, discoverability and engagement.
- Experience in sourcing, verifying and reporting news accurately and impartially, including handling breaking news and user-generated content.
- Strong broadcast skills, including radio production, interviewing and presenting for live, on-demand and visualised programme formats.
- Fluent in Pidgin and English, with a good understanding of the political, social and cultural landscape of Nigeria and wider West Africa, and the needs of Pidgin-speaking audiences.

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Angular & Data Engineering)
description:
Role Split: 70% Frontend / Application Development (Angular) | 30% Data Preparation & Engineering (Python / SQL / Spark)

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Engineer with deep expertise in Angular and a solid foundation in Python, SQL, and data engineering. You will spend roughly 70% of your time architecting and building complex, interactive simulation interfaces in Angular that interact closely with underlying databases, and 30% of your time building data preparation, transformation, and aggregation pipelines using Python, SQL, and Apache Spark.

This role is ideal for an engineer who loves building responsive, data-intensive web applications (such as scenario simulators, risk/pricing calculators, or analytical dashboards) and is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to prepare and query the underlying datasets.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend & Simulation Development (70%)

  • Design, build, and optimize complex, interactive simulation modules and dynamic user interfaces using modern Angular (v14+) and TypeScript.
  • Build responsive data grids, dynamic parameter forms, and interactive visualizations that allow end-users to run real-time "what-if" scenarios against database models.
  • Architect seamless, high-performance communication between the Angular frontend, REST APIs, and relational/analytical databases.
  • Manage complex client-side application state using RxJS / NgRx while ensuring low latency when rendering large datasets.
  • Develop and maintain backend APIs and data-prep workflows using Python (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Pandas) to clean, structure, and serve simulation datasets.
  • Write complex, performance-tuned SQL queries to extract, join, and aggregate data for frontend simulation inputs and outputs.
  • Build and optimize distributed data transformations using Apache Spark / PySpark (or collaborate closely with core data teams to prepare curated datasets).
  • Participate in end-to-end testing, code reviews, and CI/CD deployments to ensure reliable production releases.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong specialization in Angular (TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, RxJS).
  • Proven track record building data-heavy, interactive web applications (e.g., simulation tools, financial/risk modeling UIs, or complex analytics dashboards).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience integrating frontend applications with relational or cloud databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, or Databricks).
  • Hands-on experience writing Python for backend API development (FastAPI / Flask / Django) and/or data manipulation (Pandas).

Preferred Qualifications (Strong Plus)

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark / PySpark for large-scale data preparation and ETL transformations.
  • Experience with enterprise UI libraries and visualization frameworks such as AG Grid, D3.js, Highcharts, ECharts, or Angular Material.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern CI/CD practices (Git, Docker, Azure DevOps / Jenkins)

The successful candidate will have experience managing projects involving wetland delineations and permitting, threatened and endangered species, and cultural and historic resources. They will understand how these resource areas intersect with environmental review, regulatory consultations, and permitting requirements, and will be able to coordinate the technical specialists, clients, subcontractors, and agencies necessary to advance projects efficiently and compliantly.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Advanced Threat Protection
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Role**

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and [Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment](https://www.okta.com/blog/2024/02/introducing-the-okta-secure-identity-commitment/#:~:text=The%20Okta%20Secure%20Identity%20Commitment%20is%20our%20long%2Dterm%20plan,ensure%20they%20are%20best%20protected).

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

**Responsibilities:**

- Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
- Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
- Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses
- Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there
- Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
- Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants
- Establish a deep understanding of Okta Customer Identity products and infrastructure
- Build, deploy & maintain scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize AI threat defenses at scale
- Help meet our operational security commitments by thinking like an attacker, assessing the risk, and advising on mitigation strategies
- Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations and root cause analysis

**What this position is not:**

- Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work
- Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

**Requirements:**

- You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks
- You have 4+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
- You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research
- You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:

  - AWS and/or Azure security
  - Kubernetes

- You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
- You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices
- You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
- You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

**Bonus points if:**

- You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security
- You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment
- You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:
  - Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research
  - The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications
  - Identity and access management
  - Full-stack engineering
  - Site reliability engineering
  - Vulnerability and threat management
  - Governance, risk and compliance

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We are an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

ABOUT DEPLOY

Deploy is Akur8's rating engine and the final step in our end-to-end vision, where every step of pricing, from data analysis to modeling to ratemaking, sits in one modern software platform.

Deploy bridges two functions with different skills and perspectives: the actuarial side, which extracts insights from data and makes statistical business decisions, and the IT side, which maintains and productionalizes reliable systems. Handoffs between the two are slow today. Deploy removes them and increases speed to market.

Solving this takes a deep understanding of what IT teams and actuaries each need, and of the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to help insurance clients in North America and Latin America implement Deploy successfully. You will guide clients from technical discovery through onboarding, integration, and go-live.

LEADING DEPLOY IMPLEMENTATIONS

  • Own the technical outcome of complex Deploy engagements, or defined workstreams inside a larger program, from discovery through production, with the customer's team doing the build.

  • Act as the primary technical contact for insurers integrating Deploy with their policy administration system (PAS).

  • Coordinate across client IT teams, system integrators, and Akur8 product teams, and drive integration milestones with clear plans and transparent communication.

  • Isolate broken customer setups by inspecting payloads and log files, and escalate to Product or Engineering only with a developed working theory.

SUPPORTING PRE-SALES ENGAGEMENTS

  • Partner with Sales and Actuarial Data Scientists to qualify opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions on IT landscapes, data flows, and integration readiness.

  • Present integration architectures and deliver tailored product demonstrations.

  • Contribute technical input to statements of work and technical annexes.

BEING THE CLIENT'S TRUSTED PARTNER

  • Serve as the go-to technical contact throughout onboarding and delivery.

  • Run workshops, design reviews, and technical escalations in both English and Spanish, and produce customer-facing documentation in either language.

  • Review customer designs and help the customer team change them when they are wrong.

  • Identify project risks and blockers, plan mitigation with the customer, and bring in the right internal and external resources.

  • Enable customer technical teams to operate Deploy autonomously, with knowledge transfer and documentation in the customer's working language.

IMPROVING HOW WE DELIVER

  • Turn problems found in your engagements into clear input for Product and Engineering, and close the loop once resolved.

  • Build reusable assets such as integration patterns, configuration guides, and troubleshooting playbooks.

  • Work with external vendors and system integrators on shared engagements.

  • Experience in project delivery, implementation management, or customer-facing technical roles, with enough depth to work unaided on a complex Deploy engagement.

  • Insurance industry experience, with strong knowledge of policy administration systems, rating, and insurance product workflows. Guidewire experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience managing IT integrations in enterprise environments, including integrations between policy administration systems and rating or pricing engines.

  • Technical fluency (APIs, JSON, system design) and the ability to explain and defend how a rating engine behaves under a customer's actual configuration.

  • Familiarity with SaaS delivery models and onboarding processes.

  • Strong communication with technical and business stakeholders, including customer engineering and actuarial teams.

  • Ability to work through complexity and ambiguity, and to manage several projects at once.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English, both written and spoken.

**This is a full time, permanent position.**

The location of this role is either Newcastle, York, Manchester, Birmingham, Swindon, Bristol, Portsmouth (Fort Cumberland) or Cambridge, inclusive with hybrid working.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday increasing to 33 days with service, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

Our Head of Organisation Development provides strategic and professional leadership for learning and development and change management across Historic England, ensuring the organisation has the capability, skills and change support needed to deliver its strategic priorities.

The role leads the development and delivery of organisation-wide approaches to learning, leadership and management development, team development and organisational change. Working in partnership with senior leaders and colleagues across the organisation, you identify organisational needs, translate these into practical interventions and ensure that change and learning are effectively planned, delivered and embedded. Our department’s business partnering team work closely with you to provide insight to support this.

You lead and develop a small specialist team, determining priorities and deploying resources to areas of greatest organisational need and impact.

Historic England is a fascinating organisation with highly engaged and passionate teams who are very knowledgeable and committed to our cause and deliver a wide range of different activities.  We are a people focused organisation and they are our greatest asset.  This makes us a very interesting place to deliver learning and change and means that this role can have a particularly high impact on our performance.

title: Lead Software Engineer III - PxE ServiceNow
description:
As a Lead ServiceNow Software Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. Work You'll Do:
  • Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
  • Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. title: National Programme Officer (WASH)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates as well as external women candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission,, the direct supervision of the Operations Coordinator (EPC), and in close coordination with the Head of Sub-Office (HoSO) in Aleppo, the National Project Officer (WASH) will be responsible and accountable for supporting and coordinating the development, implementation, monitoring and reporting of WASH activities under the wider Emergency and Post-Crisis programme.

  1. Assist in the coordination and monitoring of the operational, administrative and financial aspects of the WASH project in accordance with IOM policies and practices as well as donor’s requirements.

  2. Keep the supervisor informed on the status of project implementation; identify gaps and suggest actions to improve implementation.

  3. Participate in the development and adjustment of work plans, project budgets, Monitoring & Evaluation tools and standard operations procedures.

  4. Coordinate the collection, verification and analysis of data and background information; update information management systems and social media platforms on project related activities including project awareness and visibility, summaries, press releases and other relevant materials.

  5. Coordinate timely preparation and dissemination of project reports in accordance with IOM procedures and donor requirements.

  6. Liaise and coordinate with donors, partners, United Nations agencies, local authorities and stakeholders and government counterparts.

  7. Contribute to the planning, development, organization and delivery of capacity building activities targeting IOM staff, government and civil society partners, implementing partners and communities.

  8. Attend relevant conferences, workshops, working groups, interagency coordination meetings, and other forums.

  9. Participate in the preparation of project proposals and a diverse range of communication products, concept notes and other planning documents.

  10. Supervise and provide training and technical guidance to project staff and implementing partners.

  11. Undertake duty travel relating to project implementation, monitoring visits, project assessments, liaison with counterparts, etc.

  12. Perform other related duties as required.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Hydrological, Hydaulic, or Sanitary Engineering or related fields from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or,

  • Master’s degree in the above-mentioned fields

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, WASH Cluster/Sector, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organizations;

  • Practical experience in designing and executing WASH (sanitary and water) projects in the Syrian humanitarian and development contact;

  • Experience working with internally displaced persons, migrants, refugees, returnees and other vulnerable groups;

  • Flexible to work in the field to supervise contractors and in the office to prepare cost estimates, Bill of Quantities (BoQ), technical specifications, schedules, and other tender documents;

  • Prior experience working with international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organization in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage;

  • Professional skill on MS office, AutoCAD, EPANET, and any other professional design related software;

  • Technical expertise in all elements of WASH programming and activities;

  • Budget and project monitoring tools;

  • Knowledge of UN and bilateral donor programming;

  • Knowledge of financial rules and regulations.

Skills

  • Excellent computer literacy including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel etc,);

  • Good knowledge and experience of AutoCAD or other design software a distinct advantage;

  • Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations and private sector entities;

  • Good supervision, coordination, and information management skills;

  • Good knowledge of the UN System, NGOs and other international organizations/institutions;

  • Strong technical knowledge of WASH global standards, best practices, and WASH needs and interventions in Syria

  • Good conceptualization, analytical and writing skills;

  • Good communication, organizational and interpersonal relationship skills;

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, fluency in English and Arabic is required (oral and written).

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

title: FISCAM Financial Systems Controls Manager, Controllership
description:

The Team

Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Applications closing on 07 December 2026, 11:59 PM

**The Role**

You will play a key role in supporting employee health, recovery and wellbeing. You'll lead injury management and return-to-work programs, partner with leaders and employees to achieve positive outcomes, and assist in initiatives that promote a safe, healthy and productive workplace.

This position is **Temporary Part time (28 hours per week) - up to February 2028.**

- Monitoring trends, compliance and opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Contributing to projects and initiatives that enhance information management, compliance and service delivery.

You will bring experience in injury management, rehabilitation or workers' compensation, along with a genuine passion for supporting people. With a collaborative approach and strong communication skills, you will help deliver positive wellbeing, recovery and return-to-work outcomes across Council.

- Experience in injury management, workers' compensation and rehabilitation, with the ability to confidently guide employees through recovery and return-to-work journeys.

- A proactive and solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to analyse information, identify opportunities for improvement and achieve positive outcomes.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, allowing you to manage competing priorities while maintaining accurate records and exceptional service standards.
- The ability to use data, business systems and technology to support informed decision-making, reporting and continuous improvement.

- Relevant certification in injury management or work health and safety (e.g., Return to Work Coordinator, Workplace Health and Safety Certification).
- Proven experience in managing injury cases, facilitating rehabilitation, and supporting employees through the return-to-work process and collaborating with healthcare providers, management, employees and workers compensation insurers to develop effective rehabilitation plans and wellbeing strategies.

**Desirable Qualifications, Licences and Experience**

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Slalom is a purpose-led, global business and technology consulting company. We help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and people, partnering with some of the world's most ambitious organizations to solve complex business challenges and create meaningful impact.

With a strong entrepreneurial culture, deep local market expertise, and a commitment to innovation, Slalom offers a collaborative environment where talented individuals can grow their careers while shaping the future of technology and business.

At Slalom, we believe that people do their best work when they can bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we foster an inclusive, supportive culture built on trust, respect, and continuous learning.

Who You’ll Work With

At Slalom, we help organizations use data and AI to solve meaningful business challenges and create lasting impact. As a Data & AI Engineer, you’ll work with clients and multidisciplinary Slalom teams to turn ideas into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions.

You’ll combine strong software and cloud engineering skills with modern AI technologies, including Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic AI. From early technical validation through production deployment, you’ll help clients build solutions that are not only innovative, but reliable, maintainable, and designed for real-world use.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and productionize Generative AI, Machine Learning, and agent-based solutions, taking use cases from technical validation and prototyping through integration into existing platforms and business processes.
  • Build and enhance AI agents, orchestration, and routing solutions using LLM technologies, APIs, and modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable technologies.
  • Develop scalable cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to enable secure, reliable, and maintainable deployment of Data & AI applications.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD and deployment pipelines for AI applications, including automated testing, monitoring, observability, and production-readiness practices.
  • Continuously improve AI solutions across performance, scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, and maintainability, while applying appropriate guardrails and responsible AI practices.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and business stakeholders in agile client teams to translate business needs into technical solutions and contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and successful delivery.

What You’ll Bring

  • Approximately 4+ years of professional experience in software, cloud, data, or AI engineering, supported by a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience building production-grade applications, services, APIs, and Data & AI solutions.
  • Practical experience with Generative AI, LLM-based applications, and Agentic AI, ideally using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, including cloud-native technologies for developing and deploying AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices and technologies such as Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, containerization, Git, automated testing, and APIs, ideally taking solutions from prototype to production.
  • Understanding of modern AI engineering concepts such as RAG, model orchestration and routing, prompt engineering, guardrails, caching, monitoring, AI observability, and cost optimization, combined with strong communication skills and very good written and spoken English.

Why You'll Love Working at Slalom

  • Competitive compensation and an attractive benefits package.
  • Flexible and hybrid working model with a strong focus on work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth.
  • Access to global expertise, leading technologies, and industry-leading clients.
  • A collaborative, people-first culture where your ideas and contributions matter.
  • Meaningful work that helps shape the future of organizations, communities, and careers.

What We Offer

  • A truly people-centric culture built on trust, inclusion, and belonging.
  • The opportunity to influence and shape recruiting strategies in a high-growth consulting environment.
  • Close collaboration with senior business leaders and industry experts.
  • International exposure through collaboration with colleagues across Europe and beyond.
  • Regular team events, wellbeing initiatives, and community engagement opportunities.
  • A place where you can grow your career while helping others build theirs.

Diversity & Inclusion

Slalom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity of thought, experience, and background drives innovation and enables us to create better outcomes for our people, clients, and communities. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

Experience developing simulations or models of electrical circuits or engineering systems using tools such as PSPICE, LTspice, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent computational software.
Experience communicating technical concepts through engineering documentation (such as design specifications, technical reports, or schematics) or technical presentations.

Hands-on laboratory experience with hardware development, power conversion prototyping, or electronic troubleshooting using standard test benches.
Familiarity with power conversion architectures (linear and switching supplies, resonant circuits, PFC, ZVS) or power distribution networks.
Knowledge of test and production methods for electronic components, magnetics, filters, or power systems.
Experience with data conversion and transmission methodologies (ADCs/DACs, RS422, LVDS, etc.).
Practical experience or coursework in motor control algorithms, inertial stabilization, or servo feedback mechanisms.

title: Lead Engineer - Analog IC Design Engineer
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Role Overview

Turing is seeking a hands-on analog IC design lead to guide engineers building an AI evaluation benchmark. You will combine circuit design and technical review with team coordination, mentoring, and client alignment. Each task requires an AI model to design a transistor-level circuit from a written specification, through device characterization, sub-block design, integration, and closure of a complete operational transconductance amplifier (OTA).

You will own technical scope and delivery quality, helping authors turn analog design problems into rigorous, reusable tasks. Human engineers author and review the tasks, reference solutions, and evaluation tools; task scores come from circuit simulation and automated netlist checks under defined rules, never from human or LLM judgment. The role centers on analog engineering, practical automation, and leading a team that can explain and defend its technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate analog engineers and task authors, assign technical ownership, set priorities, resolve blockers, and align scope and delivery expectations with the client.
  • Onboard and mentor contributors through worked examples and actionable feedback; establish shared standards for task writing, simulation, solution review, and documentation.
  • Characterize devices and design or debug current mirrors, cascodes, differential pairs, bias networks, and gain stages; review operating points, sizing, and design trade-offs.
  • Direct a benchmark of dozens of complete designs through characterization, sub-block design, integration, and closure stages.
  • Translate client objectives into precise task specifications covering subcircuit names, pin order, stage interfaces, fixtures, numerical targets, operating conditions, process corners, and measurement criteria.
  • Review golden reference solutions against stage-specific requirements, verify nominal integration, and lead final-block PVT and mismatch evaluation against defined coverage and yield criteria.
  • Oversee open-source evaluation tools using IHP SG13G2, xschem, SPICE, ngspice, and CACE or an equivalent harness; ensure graders run reproducibly and headlessly in client containers.
  • Review task packages and handoffs, keep private solution notes separate from model-visible materials, and enable the client to independently generate and grade derived tasks.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated transistor-level analog IC design experience, including device operating regions, output resistance (ro), intrinsic gain, and the relationship between device characterization and circuit sizing.
  • Experience designing and analyzing current mirrors, cascodes, differential pairs, bias circuits, gain stages, and OTAs, including gain, bandwidth, stability, headroom, and power trade-offs.
  • Practical experience with SPICE simulation, DC sweeps and operating-point analysis, AC frequency-response analysis, PVT verification, and statistical mismatch analysis, including setting defensible coverage and yield criteria.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: coordinating engineers, mentoring contributors, reviewing designs, and maintaining quality while managing delivery priorities and client expectations.
  • Experience writing precise technical specifications, reproducible testbenches, and clear design explanations that another engineer can use independently.
  • Ability to build and debug scripted, headless simulation workflows and containerized evaluation tools, and to work effectively with the required open-source toolchain.
  • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain analog design decisions, communicate uncertainty, and resolve ambiguous requirements with technical and client stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience with IHP SG13G2, xschem, ngspice, and CACE or comparable open characterization tools.
  • Experience developing engineering benchmarks, automated graders, or structured technical exercises with objective, reproducible outcomes.
  • Experience checking netlist hierarchy, validating submission interfaces, and testing evaluation tools against malformed or degenerate circuits.
  • Experience supporting AI evaluation projects, or turning expert engineering knowledge into staged problems and well-documented reference solutions.

Preferred Educational qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a closely related field
  • Preferred: Master's (M.Tech / M.S.) or PhD with a focus on analog / mixed-signal IC design or VLSI

Project Details:

  • Contract Start Date: Expected to start as soon as possible
  • Engagement: 12-14 weeks (with potential chances of extension)
  • Commitment - 40 hours/week
  • Engagement Type: Contract
  • Selection Process : The talents shorlisted will be going through 1 round of AI Interview round and 3 rounds of short interviews with our team
