description:
Join Our Team!

The DoubleTree by Hilton New York LaGuardia Airport is looking for a Chief Engineer who takes pride in a safe, well-run building. You will lead our engineering team, keep our systems running reliably, and make sure every guest and associate enjoys a comfortable, safe property.

If you are a hands-on leader who knows building systems inside and out and enjoys developing a team, we would love to meet you.

About the Role

As Chief Engineer, you will oversee the operation, maintenance, and safety of all building systems, including mechanical, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevator, and life safety. You will lead and develop the engineering team, stay hands-on with repairs and troubleshooting, manage contractors and vendors, and keep the property compliant, guest-ready, and within budget.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of all mechanical, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevator, and life safety systems
  • Develop and manage preventive maintenance programs, schedules, and repair priorities to minimize disruption to guests and operations
  • Keep public areas, grounds, pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, fitness equipment, and restrooms well maintained and up to brand standards
  • Supervise, coach, train, and evaluate engineering staff, and manage scheduling, productivity, and labor costs
  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest maintenance requests, and monitor work orders for quality and timeliness
  • Conduct routine property inspections and regular department meetings to review priorities, work orders, and safety concerns
  • Ensure compliance with fire and life safety requirements, including FDNY Fire Safety Director requirements, OSHA, and other applicable codes
  • Establish and enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and other workplace safety practices
  • Oversee inspection, testing, and maintenance of fire protection, emergency, and security systems
  • Manage outside contractors and vendors, including bids, service agreements, and quality control
  • Monitor departmental expenses and purchasing, process purchase orders through BirchStreet, and identify savings in energy, water, and equipment
  • Plan and coordinate repair and capital improvement projects with the General Manager
  • Oversee maintenance and readiness of hotel shuttle vehicles
  • Respond to and coordinate building emergencies such as flooding, leaks, power outages, equipment failures, and severe weather

What You'll Bring

  • 5–7 years of experience managing mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and building operations; hospitality, hospital, or large commercial building experience preferred
  • Experience supervising, coaching, and developing engineering staff
  • Fire & Life Safety, Fire Sprinkler and Standpipe, and HVAC certifications
  • Boiler operating certification or applicable boiler license
  • FDNY Fire Safety Director certificate, refrigeration, or electrical licenses preferred
  • Working knowledge of building codes, OSHA, EPA, indoor air quality practices, and asbestos O&M plans
  • Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and computerized maintenance and work order systems
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field preferred; equivalent training and experience considered

Schedule & Requirements

  • Full-time, non-exempt position reporting to the General Manager
  • Valid driver's license
  • Availability to respond to facility emergencies, including outside regular hours

POSITION: Senior/Principal Environmental Consultant
LOCATION: New Jersey, Massachusetts or Connecticut

POSITION SUMMARY

AEI is seeking a Senior/Principal level environmental consultant to be a part of AEI’s expanding Site Mitigation team. The candidate will be a primary technical leader in the northeast region with an extension into other regions nationally as opportunities arise. The candidate will work alongside other senior level technical team members to oversee the implementation of a wide array of subsurface and remedial investigations, remedial action/mitigation projects, regulatory agency negotiations, and client or legal counsel communications. The candidate will support the leadership operations for the northeast region and nationally to assist in staff oversight, maintaining project technical quality and profitability objectives, and participating in operations and technical initiatives at the region and Division level. In addition, the candidate may work directly with the Division Lead and other senior level colleagues, to initiate and implement business development, client management, and technical service expansion activities in the northeast region and nationally. This is an opportunity for an individual to join a well-established company and technical team, while also playing a significant role in the continued development of the Site Mitigation Division.

LOCATION

Freehold or Cranford, NJ AEI offices are ideal, with other remote northeast US locations considered.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Experienced Principal level environmental consultant will assist with responding to incoming proposal requests and provide technical guidance to AEI’s sales team and their clients.
Perform technical reviews of prior environmental reports and develop / guide the development of proposals for appropriate next steps.
Serve as a subject matter expert for environmental regulatory programs in one or multiple states including New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maryland and other states.
Provide technical leadership and strategic guidance on projects involving in the regulatory agencies.
Provide mentorship to junior staff and collaborate with peers regarding technical and regulatory matters as a subject matter expert.
Ability to understand and track project scopes, schedules, and budgets, and anticipate potential modifications and need for change orders
Will be responsible for overseeing and potentially managing the implementation of projects ranging from initial Phase II investigations to complex investigation and remediation projects involving regulatory oversight.
Provide senior level proposal and report reviews and perform writing of similar deliverables.
Ability to interpret data and has a strategic understanding of the required next steps.
Preparation of remedial cost estimates and environmental peer reviews.
Has strong industry relationships and maintains a favorable reputation among peers.
Maintains a current and thorough understanding of local and federal environmental regulations.
Will serve as a point of contact with regulatory agencies, clients, and their legal counsel, representing AEI and the Site Mitigation Division.
Develop cost effective and technically sound path-to-closures for a wide array of projects and environmental issues.
Participate in the operational management of the Site Mitigation east region with the Regional VP, and sometimes in the Division on a level.
May work with the Division lead to developing and implementing a Site Mitigation expansion plan for the northeast region, with potential contribution to other regions.
Depending on experience and interest, may initiate and participate in business development activities and foster relationship development on behalf of AEI and the Site Mitigation Division. Activities may include conference attendance, preparation of technical papers/blogs/presentations, and virtual or in person at client meetings.
Work collaboratively with other Senior/Principal team members and support training and oversight of junior staff.
Upholds a strong work ethic and demonstrates high quality technical consulting work.

QUALIFICATIONS

15+ years of experience as an environmental consultant performing technical work and successful project management.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong business acumen.
An entrepreneurial spirit with enthusiasm for being a primary contributor to growth. self-starter, resourceful, with attention to detail and the ability to work productively.
Senior level understanding of environmental contamination with transaction related project management a plus.
Understanding of project budgeting with operational finances a plus

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s Degree, or higher, in science related field

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS

Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG), and/or Licensed Site Remediation Professional (LSRP) or similar are appreciated
Current OSHA 40-hour \"HAZWOPER\" training certification strongly , additional Health and Safety training a plus

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The work environment will consist of primarily remote desk office work, with occasional travel to AEI offices, industry events, occasional field visits to project sites, and/or client meetings may be required. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Outdoor work requires the ability to effectively perform work in all types of weather conditions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, type, handle office, and/or field equipment, speak and hear. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, balance, kneel, or crouch. The employee may be required to travel independently and lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to focus.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & PERKS

AEI Consultants offers all full-time employees an outstanding, extensive benefits package, which among other benefits includes medical, dental, and vision benefits, paid time off and sick leave, life insurance, short-term and long-term insurance, 401K, complimentary use of AEI’s condo at Donner Lake in Truckee, CA, an Employee Referral Bonus Program, and Commuter Tax and Dependent Care Benefits.

COMPENSATION

This position offers a competitive base salary commensurate with qualifications and experience plus commission / incentives.

COMPANY CULTURE

One of the primary reasons that our employees enjoy working at AEI is our positive company culture. We offer a collaborative, flexible, and inclusive work environment where employees can engage in meaningful work, make a positive impact on our clients and communities, and are encouraged to carve out a career path within the organization that best aligns with their interests and goals. We value the contributions of our team members and prioritize employee wellness, safety, flexibility, and work/life balance.

OVERVIEW

AEI Consultants is an employee-owned consulting firm that provides comprehensive services to commercial lenders, property owners, managers, tenants, and developers, industries, institutions, government agencies, and insurers, including many Fortune 500 companies. These services include environmental, property and facility assessments, zoning and energy consulting, site investigation and remediation, industrial hygiene, land surveying, valuation, and construction risk management. AEI specializes in identifying potential risks and crafting solutions through Environmental and Building Evaluation Consulting, Construction Services, Site Investigation and Remediation expertise. AEI Consultants is known for being reliable, responsive, and resourceful. Founded in 1992, AEI is based in the San Francisco Bay area and has offices strategically located throughout the United States.

AEI Consultants values and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment for our employees and community. We encourage all applicants who are excited about this opportunity and share our career goals to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement. We are proud to offer equal employment opportunities, prohibiting discrimination and harassment based on various protected characteristics defined by law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment. title: Senior Product Manager - AI Agent
description:
#### Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

About Spark

Spark is Nexthink's personal IT agent for every employee. Built on the Nexthink Infinity platform, it combines real-time endpoint telemetry, AI-driven diagnostics, and IT-approved automation to resolve issues in seconds, with no queues, no handoffs, and no tickets.

Spark is live and adopted by enterprise customers today, resolving the majority of IT issues at first contact without human escalation. See it for yourself: [nexthink.com/platform/spark](https://nexthink.com/platform/spark)

#Li-Hybrid

#### Job Description

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core area of Spark, from problem definition through measured outcome in production.

You'll join a dedicated Spark product group, where each product manager owns a distinct part of the agent, working alongside the engineering, applied AI, and design specialists who build it. You won't be the only person in the room who understands agentic systems. You'll have peers who have shipped autonomous AI at enterprise scale, and you'll be expected to raise their game as much as they raise yours.

What You'll Do

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for your area of Spark.
- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand what employees actually experience, not what the ticket data claims they experience.
- Partner daily with engineering, applied AI, and design to ship agent capabilities that are reliable, safe, and observable. Autonomous action on an employee's device is a high-trust operation, so you'll help define the guardrails as much as the features.
- Define how success is measured, and be rigorous about what the data supports and what it doesn't.
- Drive product adoption by understanding user behavior, engagement, and the factors that influence long-term usage and value realization.
- Turn ambiguity into sequenced, defensible priorities, then communicate them clearly enough that engineering, sales engineering, and leadership all reach the same conclusion.
- Confidently defend product decisions and trade-offs using customer insights, business context, and data.
- Partner closely with go-to-market teams to ensure successful launches, positioning, adoption, and customer impact.
- Stay close to the frontier of agentic AI and translate what's newly possible into what we should build next.

#### Qualifications

Essential

- 5+ years in product management, including enterprise B2B SaaS shipped at scale.
- Experience building and managing customer-facing products (B2B or B2C), rather than internal-only tools.
- Experience shipping products where you have personally participated in evaluation design, strategy, experimentation, and iterative optimization.
- Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguity into clear priorities, and to say no with a reason.
- Fluency with data. You can query it yourself, and you push back when framing outruns evidence.
- Excellent written and spoken English, with the range to move between an engineering standup and an executive pre-read.
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for product outcomes.
- Experience collaborating with commercial and go-to-market stakeholders to bring products successfully to market.
- Ability to break down complex problems into structured initiatives, milestones, and deliverables.

Nice to have

- Background in ITSM, IT operations, or digital employee experience.
- Experience building or launching AI-powered products.
- Experience taking products or major features from 0 to 1.
- Experience with proactive engagement products such as notifications, campaigns, and nudges, where the hard problem is earning attention without becoming noise.
- Experience with conversational or channel integrations (Teams, ServiceNow, voice).

We know strong candidates rarely tick every box. If you meet most of the essentials, apply.

Why Join Us

- Work on a shipped, differentiated AI product with real enterprise adoption, not a pilot searching for a use case.


- Build autonomous agents on one of the richest real-time endpoint data foundations in the industry.


- A small, senior product group with genuine ownership and short paths to decisions.


- Hybrid working, a global team, and a learning budget.


Nexthink is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and are happy to adjust the process for accessibility needs. Just tell us what would help.

#### Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! **Check what we offer:**

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Beautiful office, conveniently located next to the Prilly-Malley train station

title: Delivery & Operations Lead
description:
About Cerrion

At Cerrion, we're building the future of AI-enabled manufacturing. Headquartered in Zurich with more than $25M in funding from Creandum, Y Combinator, and top Silicon Valley investors, we're building the industrial AI platform to deploy AI Agents that can see what's happening on the production floor, automatically spot problems, and instantly intervene to keep lines running smoothly, at scale. Our technology is live in factories across 18+ countries, helping leading manufacturers in glass, beverage, food, CPG, building materials, and wood cut downtime by up to 50%.

About the Opportunity
As Delivery and Operations Lead, you’ll hire and lead a team of data annotators and delivery engineers whose work goes straight into the AI models running on our customers’ production lines.

You’ll run the team day to day. That means planning capacity, keeping quality and output on track, developing your people, and making sure Wrocław and our engineering and customer success teams in Zurich work as one. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who likes building structure where none exists yet.

What You’ll Own

  • Build the Wrocław delivery centre: hire and onboard data annotators and delivery engineers, and set the foundations of how the team works.

  • Lead and develop the team: set clear expectations, coach people, address underperformance, and resolve day-to-day people issues.

  • Plan capacity: forecast workload and plan staffing, leave and coverage so the team meets agreed quality, productivity and delivery targets.

  • Connect Wrocław with Zurich: align delivery and support priorities with engineering and customer success, flag risks early, and see issues through to resolution.

  • Improve how we deliver: document workflows and turn recurring problems and team feedback into concrete improvements to our delivery tools and processes.

  • Run local operations: organise the office and coordinate HR administration with the relevant specialists.

We’d Love to Hear from You If

  • You have an engineering background.

  • You have hired and directly managed teams in service delivery, customer support, data operations or a comparable environment.

  • You have a track record of managing quality, productivity and staffing, and of building or improving processes in a growing organisation.

  • You have strong people-management skills and practical judgment, and you solve problems independently and follow through.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively: you spot risks early, propose solutions and keep colleagues informed.

  • You pick up software tools and technical workflows quickly, work comfortably with performance data, and enjoy collaborating with engineers.

  • You speak strong professional English and Polish.

  • You can work primarily from our Wrocław office, with some flexibility.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation or AI model delivery.

  • Experience setting up a new team or operations centre.

Why This Role Is Different
You start with a new office and a clear mandate. The team, the processes and the culture in Wrocław will be the ones you build. Your work has a direct line to production, because every annotation and delivery your team ships improves the AI that runs in factories worldwide.

Why Cerrion

  • Impact: Lead the team that makes our AI work on real production lines across 24 countries.

  • Growth: Build a function from day one, with your scope growing as our delivery footprint grows.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

  • Work environment: A new office in Wrocław, flat hierarchies and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Culture: Work alongside AI PhDs, ex-Googlers, and serial entrepreneurs from around the world, with regular team events.

Cerrion is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:
The Survey Manager leads Ascent Geomatics Solutions' field and office survey team for the DJ Basin oil and gas program and is accountable for the survey phase of assigned projects. Reporting to the Director of Survey, the Manager develops survey work plans, assigns resources across concurrent projects, and adjusts priorities as layouts, schedules, and field conditions change. The team provides land surveying and aerial mapping for well sites, access roads, pipelines, and facilities, including boundary, topographic, and route surveys; construction staking and as-built surveys; and associated data processing, CAD drawings, and exhibits. This work supports planning and permitting through construction. Assigned resources may also support renewable and other energy projects.

Working closely with Project Managers (PMs), the Manager aligns survey scope, effort, and delivery commitments with overall project needs and takes ownership of survey execution problems through resolution. The role leads and develops field crews and office survey technicians, coordinates inputs with Ascent's other technical teams, and ensures work is checked and ready for its intended use. The Manager coordinates survey execution with client construction and field personnel, while PMs manage the client relationship and overall project. Professional surveying work is performed under the responsible charge of a designated PLS/RPLS; the Manager may serve in that capacity when appropriately licensed and assigned.

Summary:
The Survey Manager leads Ascent Geomatics Solutions' field and office survey team for the DJ Basin oil and gas program and is accountable for the survey phase of assigned projects. Reporting to the Director of Survey, the Manager develops survey work plans, assigns resources across concurrent projects, and adjusts priorities as layouts, schedules, and field conditions change. The team provides land surveying and aerial mapping for well sites, access roads, pipelines, and facilities, including boundary, topographic, and route surveys; construction staking and as-built surveys; and associated data processing, CAD drawings, and exhibits. This work supports planning and permitting through construction. Assigned resources may also support renewable and other energy projects.

Working closely with Project Managers (PMs), the Manager aligns survey scope, effort, and delivery commitments with overall project needs and takes ownership of survey execution problems through resolution. The role leads and develops field crews and office survey technicians, coordinates inputs with Ascent's other technical teams, and ensures work is checked and ready for its intended use. The Manager coordinates survey execution with client construction and field personnel, while PMs manage the client relationship and overall project. Professional surveying work is performed under the responsible charge of a designated PLS/RPLS; the Manager may serve in that capacity when appropriately licensed and assigned.

Expected Results in the Role:

Assigned survey work meets agreed scope, schedule, quality, and effort commitments and supports the next project milestone.

PMs have a dependable survey counterpart who provides realistic commitments, accurate progress updates, and early notice of risks with practical options for resolving them.

Field crews and office technicians work to aligned priorities, with capacity planned for collection, data processing, CAD drafting, and review.

Changes in project plans lead to timely adjustments in assignments, effort estimates, and delivery dates, with affected teams working from current direction.

Survey data, drawings, and exhibits are complete and ready for their intended use, with required review completed before release and avoidable rework reduced.

Employees receive clear expectations, effective coaching, and development support that strengthen field and office capability and dependable team coverage.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Survey Planning and PM Partnership

Serve as the survey counterpart to PMs, defining survey scope, deliverables, effort estimates, assumptions, and milestones that support overall project commitments.

Build survey work plans with clear tasks, owners, and dependencies. Confirm the information needed by field and office staff and the timing of survey inputs for other technical teams.

Assess changes to layouts, field access, drilling or construction schedules, and scope with PMs. Develop practical options, update survey plans, and communicate revised commitments.

Field and Office Resource Management

Balance field crews, office survey technicians, equipment, and review capacity across concurrent assignments. Match work to staff capabilities and set clear priorities and due dates.

Guide assigned coordinators and supervisors in daily scheduling and task management, providing direct coordination where needed. Resolve constraints between field collection and office completion of the work.

Adjust sequencing, workloads, and overtime within delegated authority, considering urgency, cost, quality, safety, and sustained team capacity. Coordinate shared resource needs with the Director of Survey and other managers.

Survey Delivery and Quality

Manage work from research and field preparation through collection, processing, and CAD drafting. Office deliverables include well location certificates, right-of-way exhibits, ALTA/NSPS surveys, and other survey exhibits.

Align collection requirements, methods, accuracy, and level of detail with intended use and designated PLS/RPLS direction. Coordinate aerial mapping and LiDAR inputs when included in the survey scope.

Build QA/QC and PLS/RPLS review into schedules, confirm review comments are resolved, and deliver current, checked survey information to PMs and receiving teams.

When appropriately licensed and assigned, sign and seal survey deliverables prepared under the Manager's responsible charge.

Confirm field readiness, access, equipment, and safe execution with field leadership and Safety and Fleet support. Address conditions or missing information that affect planned work.

Performance and Problem Solving

Review survey hours, utilization, completed work, and remaining effort against the plan. Investigate variances and give PMs reliable completion forecasts and notice of scope changes requiring action.

Take ownership of delivery problems and recovery plans. Bring the people involved together to resolve missing data, conflicting direction, bottlenecks, or missed commitments, and follow actions through completion.

Investigate recurring delays and rework, identify their causes, and implement practical improvements. Check whether changes improve quality, efficiency, and dependable delivery.

Team Leadership and Development

Coach field and office staff and assigned supervisors on work planning, technical capability, and accountability. Use project feedback and performance discussions to identify training and development needs.

Address staffing, coverage, and performance needs with HR and the Director of Survey. Recommend equipment or workflow investments with clear reasons, then implement approved improvements.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Understand, represent, and reinforce Ascent's core values.

Provide department leadership, direction, and accountability for staff and team performance.

Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and performance evaluations for direct reports.

Guide employee development through coaching, training, and career planning.

Manage performance or behavioral concerns in coordination with HR.

Lead department staffing, hiring, and onboarding in coordination with HR and leadership.

Oversee department capacity and coverage and approve personnel actions within delegated authority.

Ensure department compliance with company policies and applicable safety, quality, and professional requirements.

Required Skills & Abilities:

Survey planning and ownership: Translate scope into achievable field and office work plans, recognize dependencies, make realistic commitments, and take responsibility for delivery and follow-through.

Resource management: Balance competing assignments, staff capabilities, equipment, and review needs. Judge when to change sequencing, redistribute work, or seek additional capacity.

People leadership: Set expectations, delegate effectively, coach employees and supervisors, and address performance concerns while maintaining trust and accountability.

Survey fundamentals: Apply practical knowledge of survey control, coordinate systems, datums, units, calculations, and boundary and topographic surveying to recognize problems and involve the appropriate expertise.

Field and office workflows: Understand GNSS/RTK, total stations, data processing, and CAD drafting well enough to plan work, assess completeness and consistency, and recognize limitations requiring PLS/RPLS direction.

Problem solving and adaptability: Respond constructively to short schedules, frequent revisions, rural field conditions, and changing oil and gas project needs. Develop workable options and communicate their effects.

Effort and performance judgment: Use project, timekeeping, and resource information to evaluate progress, remaining work, utilization, and rework, and explain needed adjustments.

Team coordination and communication: Ask informed questions, resolve competing needs with PMs and technical teams, and communicate decisions clearly while demonstrating Ascent's core values.

Skills & Abilities:

Survey software: Advanced capability with Trimble Business Center, AutoCAD Civil 3D, GIS platforms, or survey databases.

Remote sensing: Familiarity with photogrammetry, aerial or terrestrial LiDAR, and their integration into survey workflows.

DJ Basin workflows: Familiarity with Colorado upstream development and survey information supporting ECMC and local permitting.

Required Education, Certifications, and Experience:

Substantial progressive land surveying experience with demonstrated understanding of both field and office operations.

At least five years of experience in project, client, and staff management, including direct responsibility for leading people and coordinating survey delivery.

Experience providing land surveying services for oil and gas projects, such as well sites, pipelines, or facilities, with direct involvement in field execution, office delivery, or survey coordination.

Experience managing concurrent survey assignments with PMs, including field and office workloads, effort planning, progress tracking, and resolution of delivery problems.

Demonstrated ability to develop staff, improve survey workflows, and coordinate technical decisions and deliverable reviews with designated PLS/RPLS staff.

Education, Certifications, and Experience:

Active Colorado Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) licensure , but not required.

Degree in Land Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or a related field.

Experience leading recurring oil and gas survey workloads across multiple concurrent projects, with deeper experience in DJ Basin well site, pipeline, or facility development.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:

Reliable internet access and a designated, quiet workspace are required.

Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods, including regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and one or more monitors.

Ability to review detailed drawings, maps, technical documentation, spreadsheets, or other role-specific materials for extended periods.

Other Need-to-Know Items:

Remote work is acceptable, provided the employee is based in and performs their work within the United States.

Standard work hours are Monday-Friday, generally aligned to Mountain Time, to support collaboration with clients and internal teams. Flexibility is supported within continental U.S. time zones, provided core team availability and communication are maintained.

Evening, weekend, or additional hours may occasionally be required to meet project deadlines or business needs.

Travel may be required on occasion for team collaboration, training, or project support.

Employment is limited to candidates authorized to work in the United States and able to perform work within continental U.S. time zones.

description:

The Environmental Planning and Permitting Technologist advances the vision and strategy for Brown and Caldwell's permitting services, with an emphasis on Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), State Environmental Policy Act (SEPA), and related environmental review and permitting requirements. This role provides technical project leadership for Categorical Exclusions, Environmental Assessments, Environmental Impact Statements, Negative Declarations, alternatives analyses, impact assessments, agency coordination, public involvement, and integration of environmental review with permitting strategy. The role also supports natural resources permitting and compliance, including wetlands and waters of the U.S. evaluations, jurisdictional delineations, habitat assessments, special-status species reviews, biological assessments, mitigation planning, and construction-phase environmental compliance.

Develop, maintain, and ensure the consistent application of technical standards, guidelines, and best practices across projects and teams.

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and developing tailored technical solutions.

title: Associate Director - FPA
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Associate Director for Business Finance & FP&A to lead key financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering functions. Who are we

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We're bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Strategic Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis

  • Own and lead the annual / Monthly budgeting, long-range planning, and forecasting processes across multiple business units
  • Build and maintain advanced financial models to support scenario planning and business strategy
  • Lead MEC process in partnership with controllers org to ensure accuracy in books closing, drive E2E forecasting & tracking the financials by working closely with Controllership, Business finance and Business teams

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Education:

Experience:

Skills:

  • Proven experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading cross-functional initiatives
  • Highly organized with strong project management and communication skills

This is your chance to fashion the future at scale - while paving your own path to growth. Ready to be the trend Be Myntra.

title: Commercial Director, Saudi Arabia
description:
About the role:

At Versuni, our purpose is simple: We turn houses into homes.

In order to deliver on this promise, we stay relentlessly consumer obsessed, operate as one team across borders, and embrace an ownership mindset in everything we do. These principles define how we work, innovate and grow.

Anchored in these values, we are now looking for a Commercial Director to drive Versuni’s commercial success in Saudi Arabia. As the clear market leader in small domestic appliances industry, this is a business-critical leadership opportunity to build on our strong market position, accelerate profitable growth, and further expand our market share across retail, distribution, and eCommerce channels.

In this role, you will have full P&L accountability for the Saudi Arabian business, including revenue, gross margin, trade investments, commercial profitability, and overall bottom-line performance. You will drive commercial strategy and execution while shaping a locally relevant product portfolio and marketing approach that responds to Saudi consumer needs and market opportunities.

As a key strategic voice for Saudi Arabia within Versuni, you will influence regional and global decisions on portfolio development, innovation, and investment priorities, while strengthening customer partnerships and commercial execution.

Beyond business results, you will lead with integrity, build trust and accountability, and foster a high-performing, collaborative culture that drives sustainable growth and long-term success.

The impact you’ll make:

Commercial Strategy and Leadership:

  • Develop and execute KSA commercial strategy aligned with Versuni regional and global priorities
  • Own Saudi market growth plans, channel priorities and sales execution across retail, distribution and eCommerce
  • Lead Sales and Marketing, partnering with Finance, Supply Chain and HR to deliver profitable growth and customer experience
  • Identify KSA market opportunities, competitive threats and evolving consumer and retailer trends

Commercial P&L Management:

  • Accountable for KSA revenue, gross margin, trade investments and commercial profitability
  • Lead annual sales planning, demand forecasts and commercial budget proposals with Finance
  • Review monthly sales, margin, customer profitability and forecast performance with regional leadership

Sales (Offline and Online), Marketing and Commercial Excellence:

  • Drive Saudi-Centric Portfolio & Marketing Strategy: Lead the development of a locally relevant product portfolio, identifying Saudi consumer needs, market trends and growth opportunities
  • Shape product selection, innovation priorities and marketing strategies to strengthen Versuni’s competitive position in KSA
  • Champion KSA Within Versuni’s Global Strategy: Act as a strong voice for Saudi Arabia within the regional and global organization, influencing strategic priorities, product roadmaps and investment allocation to ensure KSA receives the focus, resources and tailored solutions needed to unlock its full growth potential
  • Deliver sales, market share, distribution and sell-out targets across priority categories and channels
  • Drive customer joint business plans, go-to-market execution, launches, promotions and price positioning
  • Build strategic relationships with key Saudi retailers, distributors and eCommerce partners
  • Own marketing priorities and brand activation to strengthen consumer demand, digital engagement and in-store conversion
  • Build commercial excellence in pricing, trade terms, assortment, execution and sales forecasting

Team Culture:

  • Lead and develop high-performing KSA Sales and Marketing teams with clear accountability
  • Promote collaboration between commercial, Finance and Supply Chain teams to accelerate execution
  • Role model Versuni behaviors, strong engagement, talent development and performance discipline

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business or Engineering
  • 15+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience in consumer goods and/or consumer durables industries
  • Proven ownership of full P&L, including sales, margin, trade spend and channel profitability
  • Strong track record in Saudi retail, distributors, eCommerce and key account management
  • Fluency in both English and Arabic
  • Experience leading high-performing sales teams and driving cross-functional execution
  • Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and drive sustainable growth
  • Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across local, regional and global teams

What we’ll give you in return:

  • Competitive base salary | benchmarked against top companies in the local market with a global footprint
  • Competitive allowances | Housing Contribution for a better living, Transportation Allowance for commuting, Education Allowance for children, Mobile Allowance to ensure connectivity, Air ticket Contribution for self & family for non-Saudi employees
  • Sales incentive program | reflecting your contributions
  • Top-tier medical insurance plan | offering best in class insurance plan, family included
  • Product discounts | on selected Versuni products which are sold under the Philips brand
  • An office that feels like home | easily accessible and modern office location with a lot of facilities around
  • High growth environment | offering an exciting multinational work culture with local, regional and global stakeholders
  • Inclusive working culture and family spirit | we embrace our international community as competitive advantage

Ready to make an impact?

From developing game-changing air fryers to perfecting the art of coffee making, Versuni’s purpose is turning houses into homes — and we’re calling on your talent to bring it to life. Join our global team of 6,000+ passionate individuals, work with world-class brands, and shape the future of home living. We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

Title: Senior Integration Consultant

Technology: ADMS, OMS, SCADA, OT systems, integrations

Work Location: Reading/Glasgow/Perth/Aberdeen, United Kingdom


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior ADMS-OMS & OT Integration Consultant who can bridge utility operations, support ADMS upgrade, OMS transition and OT integration workstreams. The role needs hands-on understanding of GE PowerOn, utility OT operations, SCADA/OMS flows, integration patterns and control room readiness. The consultant should be able to work with architecture, cyber, infrastructure, GE and subcontractor teams to convert discovery into practical delivery actions


The candidate should be comfortable operating in a complex multi-vendor environment, asking the right questions, identifying risks early and helping to move from discovery to execution.


Key Responsibilities

PowerOn ADMS / OMS

• Support ADMS upgrade validation, environment readiness and functional impact assessment.

• Assess OMS migration impacts from SIMS to PowerOn OMS, including outage, incident, call, crew and restoration workflows.

• Identify standard PowerOn capability versus specific customization or configuration needs.

• Support PowerOn Mobile and regulatory reporting configuration assessment.


OT Architecture and Infrastructure

• Work with cyber, infrastructure and architecture teams on OT/HOTi placement, L2/L3 network impacts and virtualization dependencies.

• Support sizing inputs and application dependency mapping for ADMS environments.

• Clarify operational ownership gaps around RTU commissioning, OT networking and application support.


Integration and Data Flow

• Review SOAP, DB links, API gateway, Kafka and event-driven integration options for resilience during storm-event bursts.

• Support DERMS-to-ADMS interface discovery where included in scope.


Testing and Operational Readiness

• Build functional test scenarios for outage lifecycle, switching, SCADA events, call handling, crew dispatch and restoration.

• Support SIT, UAT, regression and operational cutover readiness.

• Convert workshops into crisp requirements, risks, actions and acceptance criteria.


Required Experience

• Strong experience in utilities, ADMS, OMS, SCADA or OT application delivery.

• Hands-on exposure to GE PowerOn Advantage ADMS; PowerOn OMS experience strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of outage management, switching, restoration, network operations and control room workflows.

• Experience in OT environments, security zones, operational availability and production support constraints.

• Ability to interpret architecture, interface, environment and infrastructure dependencies.

• Good SQL/data understanding for reporting, reconciliation and operational investigation.

• Strong workshop facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Experience

• ADMS upgrade or version migration experience, preferably GE PowerOn Advantage (ADMS S6).

• SOAP/XML integration, Oracle, DB links, Kafka, API gateway or durable messaging patterns.

• PowerOn Mobile, DERMS integration, AMI, GIS, Workforce Management or customer communications integration.

• UK DNO/DSO operations, outage reporting or regulatory reporting exposure.

• Hyper-V, Red Hat server environments and IT/OT infrastructure refresh projects.

• Power BI, Business Objects, Databricks or operational reporting modernization exposure.


Note: Applicants for employment in United Kingdom should possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.

title: Senior Product Manager, Authentication
description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the Role:
Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud’s Access & Authentication team owns it.
With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.
As a Senior PM, you’ll define how millions of users prove who they are. You’ll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you’ll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren’t a tradeoff, join us.
JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.
If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let’s have a conversation.

You’ll be responsible for:
Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.


Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.


Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.


Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

You Have:
5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.


Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.


A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.


Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

Bonus Points for:
A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

title: Solution Architect - Senior
description:
We are looking for a talented Solution Architect- Senior to join our team specializing in Systems/Information Technology for our Corporate organization in Columbus, IN .

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve efficiency, accelerate delivery timelines, and create measurable business value across the organization.
  • Design and implement cloud-native, API-driven, and microservices-based architectures that enable faster innovation, greater flexibility, and seamless system integration.
  • Lead solution architecture efforts that align with enterprise standards while ensuring interoperability, performance, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Develop modernization roadmaps that balance current business needs with future technology strategies, reducing technical debt and enabling continuous delivery.
  • Drive platform and service reuse by leveraging shared capabilities, standard patterns, and enterprise technologies to lower costs and simplify operations.
  • Partner with Enterprise and Principal Architects to influence strategic technology decisions, identify architectural gaps, and align solutions across multiple business domains.
  • Champion secure-by-design and data-centric architectures that strengthen resilience, improve decision-making through analytics, and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and infrastructure needs, leading proof-of-concept initiatives and recommending innovative solutions that support future business growth and scalability.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.

Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.

Solution Design - Translate business requirements into integrated designs, architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and align with enterprise standards and subject-matter platforms.

System Architecture- Creates and evolves architecture system blueprints developing reusable patterns and roadmaps to ensure scalability, resilience, security, and long-term efficiency.

Business Architecture - Structures capabilities, value streams, processes and operating models that translate strategy into executable designs, guide investment and transformation decisions, and deliver strategic results.

Strategic Roadmap Planning - Develops globally tuned, multi-year roadmaps that connect vision to execution—sequencing investments with capacity, risk, and measurable benefits.

Demonstrating Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs.

Strategic and Innovative Thinking - Evaluates business and technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost-aware innovation.

Technical Passion & Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.

Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.

Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.

Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.

Education, Licenses, Certifications : College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience: 6+ years of experience in solution or system architecture in large, complex organizations. Demonstrated architecture and design experience, strong knowledge of modern architectural patterns, cloud platforms and integration technologies.

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands‑on experience with React.js/Angular, Node.js, TypeScript. Java, Python, SpringBoot, supporting both new development and legacy modernization
  • Extensive experience with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, S3 etc).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).

title: Optical Engineer II
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

### **Responsibilities:**

The **Instruments and Communications Division** is known for the development and infusion of technologies that enable advanced flight sensors, instruments, and deep space communications. Our expertise spans the entire electromagnetic spectrum — from Radio Frequency (RF) through ultraviolet (UV). Our product line ranges from quantum technology and flight systems, imaging spectrometers, microwave radiometers, scientific radars, mass spectrometers and other in situ instruments, ground and space-based RF and optical systems, and innovative sensors. We create novel material systems and fabrication techniques that unlock new concepts and mission architecture. We pioneer deep space communication theory, implement advanced communication systems, and develop navigational tracking to understand where we are and how to ensure robust engineering and science data return.

The **Optics & Spectroscopy Section** provides world-leading capability and expertise in a wide range of technologies that are critical to the development of optical instruments. Section leadership and expertise are specifically applied to the development of advanced ground and space-based optical systems in the following areas: research and development of optics-related technologies; system architecture and concept definition; detailed optical system design, opto-mechanical design, analysis and implementation; and alignment, test and calibration of optical instruments and systems.

We invite you to join the Optical Engineering group to serve as an **Optical Engineer II**. You will be reporting administratively to the Group Supervisor of the Group. The Optical Engineering Group specializes in designing and developing optical systems for planetary probes and instruments, earth observing remote sensing systems, and in situ sensing systems (telescopes, cameras, and spectrometers).

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics or related technical discipline with a minimum of 3 years of related work experience; Master’s degree in similar disciplines with a minimum of 1 year of related work experience.
- An understanding of adaptive optics algorithms and optical hardware along with underlying principles, theories, concepts and techniques.
- Experience in wavefront sensing and control and or adaptive optics instrumentation. Proficiency in Matlab or Python
- The ability to work well in teams with a diverse set of skills and backgrounds
- Proficiency in word processing and spreadsheets, e.g. Word and Excel
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred Skills:**

- Hands-on experience building optical instruments

- Experience with astronomical observations

- undefined
- Familiarity with optical diffraction and refraction, and a solid mathematics foundation.
- undefined
- Familiarity with polarization

- Familiarity with CAD software, e.g. Solidworks
- Familiarity with JPL processes and practices

title: ML Engineer - LLM & Agentic Evaluations

description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview

We are hiring ML Engineers to join our AI Evaluation team, where you will help design and execute evaluations for Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI workflows. You will work alongside ML engineers, researchers, and domain experts to measure model capabilities, surface failure modes, and improve the way frontier AI systems are trained and benchmarked. This is a hands-on, research-flavored role. You will work on real evaluation problems that directly influence how leading AI models are trained, refined, and shipped

What does day-to-day life look like?
Design, build, and run evaluation suites for LLMs across reasoning, coding, math, tool use, and long-context tasks.
Develop benchmarks and rubrics for agentic workflows, including multi-step planning, tool/function calling, code execution, and browser/computer-use agents. Curate, clean, and annotate evaluation datasets; write clear task specifications and grading criteria.
Run model comparisons (open-source and frontier models), analyze results, and produce structured reports with actionable insights. Implement automated graders (programmatic checks, LLM-as-a-judge) and validate them against human reference judgments.
Investigate failure cases, characterize error patterns, and write reproducible findings for the research team.
Collaborate with engineers to integrate evaluations into internal harnesses, CI pipelines, and dashboards.
Contribute to internal documentation, best practices, and tooling improvements.


Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, including familiarity with the standard data and ML stack (NumPy, Pandas, Jupyter, etc.).
  • Working understanding of how modern LLMs are trained, prompted, and evaluated.
  • Experience interacting with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source via Hugging Face / vLLM, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and writing skills — ability to clearly document tasks, results, and recommendations.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment with overlapping collaboration hours.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.

Offer Details

description:
Project Manager–Surveying, Site Planning & Permitting (Oil&Gas)
Petroleum Field Services LLC Remote, Other / Non-US, United States

About this position
*Remote work is acceptable, provided the employee is based in and performs their work within the United States*

Summary:
The Project Manager (PM) leads assigned DJ Basin oil and gas projects in Colorado from scope development through site planning, civil design, permitting, delivery, and closeout. Reporting to the Portfolio Manager, the PM serves as the primary client contact and coordinates Surveying, Remote Sensing, GIS, Drafting, Civil Engineering, and Permitting. The role translates client objectives into defined deliverables, project phases, tasks, budgets, and timelines, then manages the dependencies and critical path connecting each department’s work.

Working with department leaders, the PM coordinates the collection of field and client information, creation of deliverables, and handoffs needed to move projects forward. The PM tracks progress and remaining effort, manages changes, and brings the right people together to resolve missing information, delays, or competing priorities. Success requires enough understanding of the services and workflows to ask informed questions and recognize how an issue in one phase affects the rest of the project. Professional land surveyors, professional engineers, and other discipline leads own technical execution, quality review, and technical approvals within their areas of responsibility. The PM coordinates these efforts to meet overall scope, schedule, budget, and quality commitments.

Expected Results in the Role:

Assigned projects meet scope, schedule, budget, and quality commitments, with risks identified early and recovery actions coordinated with the appropriate leaders.

Field information, site plans, maps, exhibits, and permitting work progress through clear departmental handoffs, with dependencies and decisions managed to support the critical path.

Clients receive clear updates, realistic commitments, and dependable follow-through, with technical questions resolved by the appropriate specialists.

Hours, remaining effort, forecasts, and invoices reflect actual project progress; unexplained variances and scope changes receive timely review and action.

Proposals and changes reflect realistic effort and delivery assumptions, with required approvals and technical reviews completed before commitments or delivery.

Delays and scope changes are addressed through coordinated solutions, timely decisions, and updated plans that keep teams and clients aligned.

Scope, Schedule, and Client Coordination

Develop scopes, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, and budgets with technical leads; confirm client and contract requirements and obtain proposal and pricing approvals.

Break projects into phases and tasks with clear owners, effort estimates, milestones, dependencies, and a critical path; align timelines with department capacity.

Serve as the primary client contact, lead status discussions, secure decisions, and communicate progress, risks, and revised commitments.

Survey, Mapping, and Field Coordination

Coordinate survey and remote sensing work through department leaders, aligning collection needs, field access, resources, and delivery dates with project dependencies.

Track the creation and transfer of survey data, maps, exhibits, and revisions between Survey, GIS, Drafting, and downstream teams.

Confirm receiving teams have the information needed to proceed; coordinate follow-up on missing inputs or concerns raised by technical reviewers.

Civil Site Planning and Permitting Coordination

Obtain client information, layout preferences, design criteria, and decisions for technical teams developing site plans, access, utilities, grading, and drainage.

Track decisions and revisions affecting multiple departments, confirming that teams receive current direction and incorporate changes into their work.

Integrate engineering deliverables and ECMC, local, and applicable federal permitting milestones and review cycles into the schedule with Civil Engineering and Permitting.

Project Controls, Change, and Problem Solving

Review weekly hours, costs, progress, and remaining effort with technical leads; investigate variances and update budgets and forecasts.

Complete time and expense reviews, resolve coding questions, and approve invoices within delegated authority; obtain required approvals for commercial exceptions.

Assess scope changes with affected departments, document impacts, and secure required approvals before revising budgets, schedules, or client commitments.

Identify delays and risks to the critical path; work with teams to develop alternatives, adjust sequencing or resources, and elevate decisions with recommendations.

Quality, Project Records, and General Duties

Coordinate required technical reviews and track comment resolution before delivery; discipline leads retain responsibility for technical quality and approval.

Maintain project records, complete closeout and final billing, and share lessons learned that improve planning and handoffs.

Follow company safety, quality, and data-security requirements; maintain accurate time records and perform other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
No direct supervisory responsibilities; provides technical guidance, mentoring, and support for the development of other team members.

Required Skills & Abilities:

Project planning and scheduling:

Define scope, break projects into phases and tasks, and maintain schedules that reflect dependencies, resource needs, and the critical path.

Service and workflow understanding:

Working knowledge of survey/geospatial, civil/site, environmental, or permitting delivery sufficient to coordinate inputs, deliverables, and handoffs across related services.

Problem solving and change management:

Recognize threats to project commitments, assess impacts with technical teams, and develop workable options with clear decisions and follow-through.

Client and team coordination:

Clarify client requirements, manage concurrent assignments, secure decisions, and align commitments with department capacity and technical guidance.

Collaborative leadership and influence:

Build trust and gain agreement across departments without direct supervisory authority. Understand competing priorities, involve others in developing solutions, and use tact when providing feedback, resolving disagreements, and addressing missed commitments while maintaining productive working relationships.

Financial and effort judgment:

Interpret budgets, hours, progress, and remaining work; investigate variances with technical leads and apply scope and approval requirements.

Organization and teamwork:

Maintain reliable project records, use Microsoft 365 and project tools effectively, and collaborate across departments while demonstrating Ascent’s core values.

Skills & Abilities:

Survey and remote sensing workflows:

Familiarity with field access, data collection schedules, office processing, and delivery of survey and mapping information needed by other teams.

Mapping and drafting workflows:

Familiarity with how GIS and Drafting teams use project information to prepare maps, drawings, and exhibits, including coordination of source information and revisions.

Civil site planning:

Familiarity with civil site planning and design workflows for well sites, access roads, and related infrastructure, including the inputs and decisions engineering teams need.

Permitting workflows:

Familiarity with how permit applications, supporting deliverables, agency reviews, and decisions fit into project schedules, including ECMC and local permitting workflows.

DJ Basin and oil and gas knowledge:

Familiarity with upstream oil and gas operations, terminology, and the sequence of site development in the DJ Basin.

Spatial review tools:

Familiarity with GIS or CAD viewers for accessing shared project information and supporting communication about deliverables and revisions.

Required Education, Certifications, and Experience:

3+ years of project management or project coordination experience in surveying, engineering, GIS, environmental services, permitting, energy, or related professional services, including responsibility for scope, schedules, budgets, and client communication.

Experience coordinating technical teams, field and office handoffs, and client-facing delivery of site, survey, mapping, permitting, or related project work.

Experience preparing proposals, project budgets, and effort estimates, and tracking project performance and scope changes.

Education, Certifications, and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Surveying, Geomatics, GIS, Engineering, Environmental Science, Construction Management, Business, Project Management, or a related field.

Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar project management certification.

Experience delivering Colorado upstream oil and gas site planning and permitting projects, or other energy and infrastructure work involving multiple technical services.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:

Reliable internet access and a designated, quiet workspace are required.

Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods, including regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and one or more monitors.

Ability to review detailed drawings, maps, technical documentation, spreadsheets, or other role-specific materials for extended periods.

Other Need-to-Know Items:

Remote work is acceptable, provided the employee is based in and performs their work within the United States.

Standard work hours are Monday-Friday, generally aligned to Mountain Time, to support collaboration with clients and internal teams. Flexibility is supported within continental U.S. time zones, provided core team availability and communication are maintained.

Evening, weekend, or additional hours may occasionally be required to meet project deadlines or business needs.

Periodic travel may be required for project coordination, client meetings, site visits, and team collaboration.

Employment is limited to candidates authorized to work in the United States and able to perform work within continental U.S. time zones.

Strong familiarity with project management and construction management systems such as Procore, SAP, or similar platforms.

Experience developing or reviewing project financial models, cost estimates, budgets, and commercial assumptions.

Strong analytical skills related to energy markets, project economics, pricing, supply chain risk, and market trends.

Experience with utility‑scale solar PV, BESS, wind, or other renewable and power technologies.

Experience navigating utility interconnection processes, transmission and distribution infrastructure, or grid development.

Experience working as an owner’s representative, developer, utility, EPC contractor, engineering firm, or other organization supporting the development and delivery of energy infrastructure.

Existing relationships with developers, utilities, EPCs, engineering firms, or other stakeholders within the renewable energy and power industry.

Based in Las Vegas, NV, or willing to work remotely with the ability to travel regularly to project sites and client locations.
