title: DevOps Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DevOps Engineer based in the United States. As a DevOps Engineer, you will lead the design, management, and continuous improvement of cloud infrastructure supporting critical healthcare technology and business operations. You will primarily work with Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with additional exposure to AWS, building secure, scalable, and cost-efficient environments. Combining cloud architecture expertise with infrastructure automation and DevOps practices, you will oversee CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and platform reliability. You will also drive cloud governance, security, compliance, and cost optimization initiatives in a regulated healthcare environment. Working autonomously, you will collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, and product teams to modernize platforms and improve delivery processes. This hands-on technical leadership opportunity offers significant ownership and influence over enterprise cloud strategy and operations.
Accountabilities As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and operating cloud environments, strengthening infrastructure automation, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing technical guidance across engineering and IT teams.

* Cloud Infrastructure Management

* Design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve cloud environments across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, with additional AWS support as needed. * Manage cloud subscription and project structures, landing zones, resource organization, tagging standards, and development, testing, and production environments. * Implement and maintain identity and access management using least-privilege principles, including Entra ID, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM, managed identities, workload identities, and identity federation. * Design and manage cloud networking components, including VNets, VPCs, subnets, routing, hub-and-spoke architectures, private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity. * Oversee capacity planning, infrastructure lifecycle management, patching, and upgrade planning for cloud-hosted services.

* Cloud Architecture and Governance

* Apply Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Well-Architected Framework principles to improve reliability, security, cost efficiency, operational excellence, and performance. * Lead cloud architecture and well-architected reviews, document findings, prioritize remediation activities, and monitor improvements through completion. * Establish and enforce cloud governance standards and policy-as-code controls using Azure Policy, GCP Organization Policy, and related technologies. * Drive FinOps initiatives, including cost visibility, resource allocation, infrastructure right-sizing, reserved capacity planning, committed-use optimization, and anomaly detection. * Maintain architecture diagrams, technical design documents, infrastructure standards, and operational runbooks.

* Automation, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), primarily using Terraform, with Bicep, ARM, and native GCP tooling where appropriate. * Develop reusable and version-controlled infrastructure modules, remote state management, and drift detection capabilities. * Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitLab, GitHub Actions, or comparable platforms. * Integrate automated validation, security scanning, approval workflows, and environment promotion into deployment processes. * Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, and Bash to eliminate repetitive manual tasks and improve operational efficiency. * Select, implement, and support development, testing, automation, and IT infrastructure tools while advising teams on DevOps practices and release management. * Support containerized platforms and services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), along with their underlying cloud infrastructure.

* Security, Compliance, and Reliability

* Implement and maintain cloud security controls aligned with HIPAA, HITRUST, and internal security requirements, including encryption, key and secret management, network segmentation, centralized logging, and vulnerability remediation. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams on assessments, audits, evidence collection, and remediation activities. * Establish observability solutions using tools such as Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Observability, and Datadog. * Maintain monitoring metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards while participating in incident response and root cause analysis. * Design, implement, and test backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability strategies with clearly defined recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO).

* Technical Advisory and Collaboration

* Advise engineering, product, and IT leadership on cloud architecture, platform selection, infrastructure migrations, and modernization strategies. * Translate stakeholder requirements into practical cloud and automation solutions while clearly communicating technical trade-offs. * Evaluate emerging cloud services, infrastructure technologies, and AI-assisted engineering tools, recommending adoption when they provide measurable value. * Mentor infrastructure and development team members while contributing to technical documentation, standards, and best practices.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines extensive cloud engineering experience with strong automation capabilities, infrastructure architecture knowledge, and the ability to independently manage complex technical initiatives in a regulated environment.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or systems engineering. * Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure, including landing zones, networking, Entra ID, and governance through Azure Policy and RBAC. * At least 2 years of practical experience with Google Cloud Platform, including organization and project structures, IAM, VPC networking, Compute Engine or GKE, and Cloud Observability. * Working knowledge of Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Well-Architected Frameworks, with demonstrated experience applying their principles to assess and improve production workloads. * Minimum 3 years of experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with Bicep and ARM considered acceptable alternatives. * Strong experience with Git-based workflows and version control. * At least 3 years of experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated build, delivery, and release tools such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions. * Minimum 3 years of automation scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash. * Experience managing Microsoft-based infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 integrations. * Knowledge of hybrid connectivity between cloud environments and on-premises infrastructure. * Experience securing infrastructure and handling protected information, including Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII), in HIPAA, HITRUST, or similarly regulated environments. * At least 3 years of experience working in Agile delivery environments. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills, combined with excellent written and verbal communication abilities. * Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, take ownership of technical initiatives, and deliver projects from planning through implementation.

Additional qualifications considered an advantage:

* Hands-on experience with AWS accounts and Organizations, IAM, VPC networking, and core compute and storage services. * Relevant professional certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or FinOps Certified Practitioner. * Experience with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, policy-as-code, and cloud observability platforms. * Previous involvement in cloud migrations, platform consolidation, or mergers and acquisitions (M&A) involving cloud and identity environments. * Linux administration experience. * Familiarity with Jira and Confluence.

Benefits

* Competitive annual base salary ranging from $115,000 to $155,000. * Eligibility for an annual cash bonus, depending on applicable compensation arrangements. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * Life insurance coverage. * 401(k) retirement plan. * Remote work opportunity. * Opportunities to work with modern cloud technologies across Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS. * Significant technical ownership and opportunities to influence cloud architecture, automation, and infrastructure strategy. * Professional development opportunities through exposure to cloud security, DevOps, infrastructure modernization, and regulated healthcare technology.

title: Senior NVIDIA Network Engineer InfiniBand - Ethernet
description:
Hiring: Senior NVIDIA Network Engineer – InfiniBand / Ethernet

Location: Chennai, India

Experience: 7–15 Years

Work Mode: Onsite/ Hybrid

Schedule: On-call support for P1 network incidents

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced NVIDIA Network Engineer with strong expertise in InfiniBand (HDR/NDR), RoCE v2, and high-performance data center networking.

You will design, deploy, optimize, and support ultra-low-latency network fabrics powering large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters (approximately 10K GPUs) for AI/ML training and inference workloads.

Must-Have Technical Skills

  • InfiniBand Networking: HDR/NDR, IB routing, credit management, timers, fabric troubleshooting, and congestion control.
  • High-Performance Ethernet: RoCE v2, PFC, ECN, MTU, buffer tuning, QoS, and GPUDirect RDMA.
  • Network Architecture: Leaf-spine, ECMP, east-west InfiniBand fabrics, north-south Ethernet connectivity, BGP, and EVPN.
  • GPU Cluster Networking: NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, NCCL collectives, all-reduce optimization, UCX, SHARP offloads, and distributed AI training communications.
  • NVIDIA Networking Platforms: NVIDIA Spectrum/Quantum switches, UFM, NetQ (or equivalent), Cumulus, Onyx, and SONiC.
  • Network Automation: Ansible, Terraform, configuration automation, and change control.
  • Performance Monitoring: iperf, NCCL-tests, sFlow, telemetry, throughput/latency monitoring, and congestion analysis.
  • Network Operations: Switch OS/firmware lifecycle, optics and cable qualification, inventory, spares, and day-2 fabric health.
  • Incident Management: P0/P1 incident response, path failures, fabric partitions, link flaps, slow-drain, credit starvation, RCA, and post-incident improvements.
  • Security: BGP/EVPN multi-tenancy, ACLs, role-based fabric manager access, configuration signing, and change control.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and operate InfiniBand HDR/NDR and Ethernet network fabrics supporting large-scale GPU clusters.
  • Configure and optimize RoCE v2, PFC/ECN, MTU, buffer profiles, IB routing, and SHARP/UCX offloads.
  • Validate NCCL collective performance and troubleshoot all-reduce bottlenecks across GPU pods.
  • Implement QoS classes for training, inference, and control-plane traffic.
  • Monitor fabric congestion, slow-drain, link failures, and network stability.
  • Automate network configurations using Ansible and Terraform.
  • Lead P0/P1 incidents involving InfiniBand, RoCE, Ethernet, NCCL, and GPUDirect RDMA.
  • Develop operational runbooks, improve network resilience, and implement graceful degradation.
  • Track fabric throughput/latency SLOs, congestion events, NCCL throughput variance, and change success rates.

Qualifications

  • BE/B-Tech or equivalent in Computer Science or Electronics & Communication.
  • 7–15 years of data center networking experience.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in InfiniBand HDR/NDR and RoCE tuning at scale.
  • Strong understanding of GPU cluster communication patterns and distributed AI/ML workloads.

Preferred Certifications

  • NVIDIA Networking Certification
  • CCNP Data Center / CCIE Data Center
  • JNCIP-DC
  • Arista ACE

title: Section Head, Systems & Process Assurance
description:
Requisition Id 17476

**Overview:**

We are seeking a Section Head to lead the Systems & Process Assurance (SPA) Section in the Isotope Science and Enrichment Directorate (ISED) Centrifuge Enrichment Technology Division (CETD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).   .

ORNL is the largest US Department of Energy science and energy laboratory, conducting basic and applied research to deliver transformative solutions to compelling problems in energy and security. ORNL has an extraordinary 80-year history of solving the nation’s biggest problems.

CETD serves the nation in two critical areas: advancing enrichment technologies and exploring enriched stable isotope production and applications. The division leverages an elite staff of scientists and engineers with the world-leading capabilities of Oak Ridge National Laboratory to deliver groundbreaking advancements with a variety of applications, from national security to life-saving medical treatments.

The SPA Section is responsible for providing division-wide services in support of the strategic advancement of science and technology focused on the research and development of prototype enrichment devices for processing uranium-bearing and stable isotope compounds. The Section is responsible for the following functions:

- Document Control and Records Management
- Systems Administration
  - Engineering Systems
  - Classified Network Systems
  - ERP/Business Systems
- Performance Assurance
  - Issues Management
  - Technical Experiences

Additionally, the SPA Section Head serves as the liaison between CETD and the Quality Assurance Division’s CETD Quality Assurance Team, ensuring the appropriate development, implementation, and effectiveness of Quality Programs supporting multiple programs and projects. This Section works closely with division and project personnel to ensure the identified systems and capabilities which support organizational, program, and project objectives are developed and maintained.

**Major Duties/Responsibilities:**

The Section Head works closely with the Division Director, CETD leadership, and section Group Leaders to establish and implement the technology directions for the section; support the Group Leaders to ensure their success and the success of the section groups; ensure that staff members understand business opportunities; model proper Environment, Safety, Security, Health, and Quality practices; and ensure a diverse and inclusive work environment where every employee feels safe, heard and appreciated—a workplace that sets an example for the broader community. The Section Head also ensures that the section meets its goals by developing and demonstrating processes and procedures.

Key leadership activities include:

- Supporting the Division Director in the operation of the Division and representing the Division Director as needed.
- Working with the section Group Leaders to establish, communicate, and measure critical metrics for success and impact.
- Actively contributing to shaping the Division’s, Directorate’s, and Laboratory’s research plans and investments.
- Building strong teams by collaborating across ORNL and securing external expertise when needed.
- Working with the Group Leaders and the Division Director to assess individual staff performance across the section. Evaluating progress regularly, providing feedback, and addressing performance issues in a timely manner.
- Developing and implementing succession planning with input from Group Leaders for all critical positions in the Section to ensure future success.
- Ensuring groups recruit and hire from a diverse pool of top candidates and aspire to be the best in their field.
- Approving job offers.
- Driving staff promotions and development.
- Addressing all concerns expressed by staff and any disciplinary actions in a timely manner.
- Leading by example, using the principles in ORNL’s “Research Code of Conduct” as a guide for proposing, performing, andcommunicating, and in dealing with others.
- Employing best practices, such as holding regular meetings, being visible in the workplace, monitoring budgets, acknowledgingsponsors, and adhering to ORNL business systems requirements regarding staff requests for foreign travel and submission of quality proposals.
- Coaching and mentoring staff regarding Battelle’s “Safe Conduct of Research” principles and ensuring all work is carried outsafely, securely, and in compliance with ORNL policies, standards, and procedures.
- Exemplifying a commitment to “One ORNL” by modeling lab expectations for excellence in research, operations, andcommunity engagement, and by working cooperatively to leverage capabilities across the lab.
- Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

The Systems & Process Assurance Section Head service expectations include:

- Serving as direct supervisor for section Group Leaders.
- Managing division workforce planning efforts, to include staffing plans, hiring, attrition, and coordination with space planning.
- Counseling/consulting/mentoring staff and transferring knowledge of specialized field(s) to a variety of staff, including senior staff.
- Assisting Group Leaders (and R&D staff when appropriate) in setting long-term career goals. Identifying additional mentors as appropriate and engaging senior staff to act in this capacity.
- Being open and transparent in communicating information to your groups and communicating staff achievements and changes to stakeholders in a timely manner.
- Working with Group Leaders to ensure staff actively participate in professional service (engagement in scientific societies,workshop and conference organization, peer review, advisory board membership, etc.).
- Advocating for and supporting internal and external recognition of staff achievements. Ensuring the Section’s external professional presence is strong.
- Communicating funding/proposal opportunities to staff and supporting proposal development as appropriate (mentoring, proposal reviews, budget preparation, etc.).
- Effectively communicating the importance of protecting proprietary or sensitive information and complying with ORNL cybersecurity policies and guidelines.

The Systems & Process Assurance Section Head has the following accountabilities:

- To section staff, for the quality and safety of their work environment and opportunity for professional growth.
- To organization managers, for world-leading science and technology directions, safe effective, and compliant operations,ownership of assigned staff, facilities, and equipment, and the quality of section products and services.
- To customers, for the quality of products and services.

The Section Head has the following authorities:

- Develop a vision and implement a strategy to pursue world-leading science and technology directions for the section.
- Hold Group Leaders accountable for performance.
- Act to ensure safe and effective operations.
- Hire group leaders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

- MS degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience or a BS with 12 years of relevant experience
- Active DOE Q security clearance which requires US Citizenship
- Qualified candidates should have demonstrated experience in leading R&D and/or R&D support organizations
- Experience operating within DOE and other government-regulated environments, including classified computing systems, sensitive information protection, compliance programs, and secure infrastructure supporting mission-critical operations.
- Experience with and ability to build strong teams within an organization and have them work together to complete a task or mission
- Experience supporting multiple organizations within a project or program
- Experience implementing quality programs and requirements
- Experience with the marking, handling, and storage requirements of sensitive documents (e.g., CUI, ECI, UCNI, CRD, SRD)
- Excellent written and oral communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience within the isotope enrichment industry
- Experience working in all phases of R&D, including preparation for routine operations/production; implementation of a graded approach to quality
- Advanced knowledge of ASME NQA-1 and/or ISO 9001 quality standards
- Experience in developing/managing Information Systems (e.g., engineering, document control, business)
- Experience managing systems administration and support organizations, including IT hardware and software environments, ERP lifecycle management, enterprise application administration, cybersecurity, infrastructure security, regulatory compliance, resource management, and support of multiple organizations across complex projects and programs.
- 10+ years of relevant experience in information security, classification, UCNI, declassification, or potentially classified subject areas; with increasing responsibilities for managing, implementing, planning, evaluating, and assessing this type of work
- Ability to function well in a fast-paced environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to frequently changing needs
- Motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and to participate creatively in collaborative teams across the laboratory

**Special Requirements:**

- This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program.

**About ORNL:**

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

description:
Role Overview

Join the team shaping how SoftwareOne uses Microsoft Power Platform and Dynamics 365 at enterprise scale. title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure)
description:
Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure) Type: Remote Contract Location: United States (US work authorization required) Openings: 2 positions, including 1 Platform Lead Start Date: Around December 1, 2026 Duration: Multi-month engagement, with potential extension

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control. Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are building a senior engineering team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform helps operations leaders understand what is happening across their workforce, make informed decisions, take action within the enterprise systems they already use, and measure the results. We are looking for two Senior DevOps / Platform Engineers, including one Platform Lead, to design, build, secure, and operate the production infrastructure supporting this platform. The environment will run within the client's own Azure tenant, handle regulated workforce and operational data, and support isolated production deployments for individual customers. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring deep Azure expertise, infrastructure as code, cloud security, and production platform ownership. You will establish the initial build environment, develop the production infrastructure, and implement the automation, security controls, observability, and disaster recovery capabilities needed to operate a reliable enterprise platform. For the Platform Lead position, you will also own key architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and work directly with the client's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do

* Design, build, and maintain production Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, creating reusable modules and automated provisioning processes. * Establish the initial build and development environments, followed by secure, production-ready infrastructure within the client's Azure tenant. * Design and implement isolated customer deployments, ensuring strict separation of subscriptions, networking, encryption keys, and data stores. * Build repeatable infrastructure deployment processes that allow new customer environments to be provisioned consistently and efficiently. * Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time access, and break-glass procedures. * Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using client-controlled repositories and runners, including automated testing, security scanning, approval workflows, and controlled production releases. * Implement cloud security controls and support enterprise security assessments, penetration testing, compliance reviews, and vulnerability remediation. * Build observability capabilities across customer deployments, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and integration with enterprise SIEM platforms. * Design and implement resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, zone redundancy, and disaster recovery solutions, including secondary-region failover capabilities. * Define recovery objectives, conduct disaster recovery and performance testing, and document results and remediation actions. * Collaborate with application engineers, security teams, enterprise architects, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure meets operational, security, and performance requirements. * Develop operational runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and incident response procedures. * Participate in production on-call rotations, incident troubleshooting, and post-deployment hypercare. * Take ownership of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. * For the Platform Lead position, guide technical architecture, establish platform engineering standards, coordinate engineering activities, and represent the team in client architecture and security discussions.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

* Senior Azure platform engineering experience. You have designed, built, and operated production Azure environments end to end, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. You have personally implemented infrastructure rather than only maintaining environments designed by others. * Infrastructure as code. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, including reusable infrastructure modules, automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle ownership. * Security and regulated environments. You have built production platforms handling PHI or similarly sensitive data and successfully supported HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise security reviews. You have participated in penetration testing, addressed security findings, and produced technical evidence for compliance assessments. * Identity and secrets management. Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time and break-glass access, credential rotation, and secure secrets management. You understand how to eliminate long-lived credentials from pipelines and repositories. * Multi-tenant infrastructure architecture. You have designed and operated customer-isolated environments with separate networking, encryption keys, and data stores. You can automate repeatable customer deployments while maintaining strict security boundaries. * Secure CI/CD engineering. Experience building production deployment pipelines within enterprise-controlled environments, including secure runners, environment promotion, approval workflows, container and dependency scanning, and coordinated releases across multiple deployments. * Disaster recovery and resilience. Hands-on experience implementing backup strategies, zone-redundant infrastructure, secondary-region recovery environments, and documented RTO/RPO objectives. You have personally executed and validated production disaster recovery or failover tests. * Observability and production operations. Strong experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, security event monitoring, and performance testing. **Job Title: Specialist, Integration and Test Engineering**

**Job Code: 47278**

**Location: Palm Bay, FL**

**Schedule: 9/80**

**Job Description:**

Join the L3Harris Environmental Test Laboratory and help verify the performance and durability of advanced defense technology under extreme conditions. In this role, you will plan, coordinate, manage, and execute environmental test projects that evaluate products at the limits of their functional and structural designs.

You will receive hands-on training to operate climatic chambers that simulate environments ranging from polar cold and desert heat to tropical humidity, high altitudes, and the cold vacuum of space. You will also learn to operate electrodynamic shakers that replicate demanding vibration environments associated with transportation, gunfire, aircraft carrier arrested landings, and rocket launches.

You will work closely with engineers and Environmental Test Technicians in a collaborative laboratory that operates year-round. Occasional weekend, off-shift, and overtime support is required, with paid overtime. On-the-job training is provided regardless of experience level.

**Essential Functions:**

- Plan, document, coordinate, and execute environmental exposure tests on high-value, advanced hardware for defense applications.
- Prepare test documentation and support the investigation and documentation of anomalies and failures.
- Advise program teams on qualification test planning.
- Collaborate with Environmental Test Technicians to execute testing in accordance with established procedures.
- Work with engineering leadership to resolve technical and procedural issues.
- Support occasional weekend, off-shift, and overtime work as needed.

**Required Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
- At least four years of experience reading, interpreting, and executing written test procedures and processes, including documenting results and identifying procedural discrepancies.
- At least four years of experience preparing technical documentation, including test procedures, test reports, or engineering summaries.
- At least four years of experience using Microsoft Word to prepare technical documents, Excel to organize and analyze test data, and PowerPoint to communicate technical results.
- At least four years of experience coordinating test activities with Environmental Test Technicians and engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience testing avionics or space hardware.
- Experience planning or performing environmental testing, particularly in accordance with MIL-STD-810.
- Experience developing software or automation tools using MATLAB, VBA, Python, or similar languages.

Position Information
Position Title
Environmental Social Science (Tenure Track Faculty, MES)

Job Summary
This is a full-time regular* faculty position starting in the fall quarter of the 2027-28 academic year.

Evergreen's Graduate Program on the Environment seeks a faculty colleague to help students understand the social dimensions of environmental issues. We anticipate that successful candidates will come from disciplines such as sociology, geography, anthropology, economics, political ecology, public policy, or interdisciplinary environmental studies. We are especially interested in candidates with expertise in the economic, social, cultural, health, or policy dimensions of environmental studies. The ability to teach social science methodologies (qualitative and/or quantitative) to students with diverse backgrounds in both the natural and social sciences is more important than the specific area of expertise. The ideal candidate will have the ability to help students develop an empirically grounded and/or systemic analysis of historical causes, current patterns, and policy solutions to environmental problems. Expertise in tribal community responses to environmental issues and Indigenous ecological knowledge systems would be especially helpful. The Evergreen Master of Environmental Studies program organizes its curriculum through interdisciplinary courses, with faculty teams collaborating across disciplines to design and teach an integrated graduate-level curriculum. The ideal candidate has the ability and passion to integrate the study of social and natural sciences through study and application of real-world issues.

A successful candidate must be able to: 1) teach foundational material and advanced topics within the environmental social sciences, which might include areas such as ecological/environmental economics, environmental policy, sustainable development, common pool resource governance, Indigenous ecological knowledge systems, tribal natural resource management, environmental health, political ecology, environmental justice, or social movements for the environment; 2) teach in interdisciplinary teams with natural scientists at the graduate level; 3) help students develop their academic writing skills; 4) help students develop quantitative research skills in environmental social sciences; 5) help students develop other analytical and methodological tools employed in the environmental social sciences, which might include research design, survey design and analysis, qualitative methods, quantitative methods, mixed methods, and/or Geographical Information Systems; and 6) mentor thesis students in diverse research projects in the environmental social sciences.

The position is a regular continuing faculty member dedicated to graduate students, with primary teaching responsibilities in-person in the evening and substantial responsibilities for advising thesis research. Faculty in this position are invited to rotate occasionally into the undergraduate daytime curriculum to contribute to the Environmental Studies Path.

*Regular is equivalent to tenure-track at other colleges. A complete description of the continuing contract and conversion process can be found in the

Collective Bargaining Agreement, article 11

.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. Employment-based visa sponsorship may be considered depending on the candidate's current immigration status; however, the College is unable, at this time, to sponsor new H1B petitions that could potentially incur the $100,000 announced in September 2025.

Job Expectations
Evergreen uses narrative evaluations in lieu of grades, and full-time faculty are generally responsible for evaluating 15 students per quarter in MES courses. Faculty are also responsible for advising students in their respective area(s) of expertise regarding skill development, career opportunities, and thesis research projects. MES faculty are expected to participate in College and MES program governance.

Our students, faculty and staff create learning communities to understand environmental problems and solutions. We teach our students to develop quantitative and technical skills, think critically and creatively, communicate effectively, value and equity, and work collaboratively to address environmental challenges.

All requirements for the position must be completed at the time of hire. Salary for all positions is based on experience and degrees (see

Salary Grid

for more information).

A complete list of faculty responsibilities is in the

Collective Bargaining Agreement .

Minimum Qualifications
Ph.D. in Social Science, Environmental Studies, or related field;
Undergraduate or graduate teaching experience in the environmental social sciences;
Ability to teach research design, quantitative and/or qualitative research methods;
Ability to mentor graduate students in thesis research and writing.

Qualifications

Graduate training in interdisciplinary research;
Experience or demonstrated interest in interdisciplinary team-teaching;
Research or teaching experience in multiple areas of desired expertise;
Expertise in tribal community responses to environmental issues and/or Indigenous ecological knowledge systems.

The college will contact current and past employers to verify this information. About Evergreen
Evergreen is an innovative, public, liberal arts college emphasizing integrated interdisciplinary study and collaborative team-teaching throughout the undergraduate curriculum and in three graduate programs. Teaching is the central work of the faculty at both the undergraduate and graduate levels. Successful teaching at Evergreen requires broad-ranging intellectual curiosity, the ability to formulate interdisciplinary questions, and the pedagogical skills to support our diverse student population.

If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills,

Position Summary
The Supplier Quality Engineer - Electrical owns the quality of electrical equipment and systems purchased for PowerFLX packages and turnkey power plants, from supplier qualification through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and release for shipment. This is a hands-on, supplier-facing role. The SQE - Electrical reviews and approves Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), witnesses and executes FATs and functional testing, and holds suppliers accountable to specification, schedule, and corrective action. The role runs a standing cadence of supplier quality and progress reviews so issues are caught at the supplier, not at receiving or on site.

Reports To:

VP Sourcing

Work Location:

300 Executive Center Dr, Suite 101, Greenville SC, 29615 ; 8310 McHard Road, Houston, TX 77053 ; 2001 Proenergy Blvd, Sedalia, MO 65301 or Remote United States

Position Responsibilities
Purchased electrical equipment and components supporting PowerFLX packages built in Sedalia and turnkey power plant balance of plant:

Generators, excitation systems, and neutral grounding equipment

Power distribution center (PDC) enclosures, control panels, cabinets, and electrical equipment

Controls hardware and subassemblies for turbine, generator, and balance of plant control systems

Low- and medium-voltage switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), and bus duct

Generator step-up, auxiliary, and dry-type transformers

UPS, battery, and DC power systems; variable frequency drives (VFDs) and motors

Protective relay and metering panels; instrumentation for turbine, emissions, and auxiliary systems

Heat tracing and winterization electrical; cable, harnesses, and terminations

Supplier Oversight and Review Cadence

Review cadence: Own and chair a standing quality and progress review with each assigned supplier. Set frequency by risk (weekly for critical or underperforming suppliers, biweekly or monthly for stable suppliers). Publish action items and hold owners to dates.

Schedule progression: Track supplier manufacturing progress against milestone schedules and promised ship dates. Escalate slippage and quality risk to Project Management and Supply Chain before it impacts delivery.

Vendor visits: Plan and conduct on-site visits at key production stages: pre-production kickoff, in-process inspection, and pre-FAT readiness review.

Surveillance plan: Maintain a risk-ranked supplier surveillance plan. Increase review and visit frequency when supplier performance declines.

ITP, FAT, and Electrical Testing

ITP ownership: Review, comment on, and approve supplier ITPs, test procedures, and quality plans. Set hold, witness, and review points aligned to purchase order requirements and applicable standards.

Contractual requirements: Flow inspection and test requirements into purchase orders and technical specifications so quality is contractual, not assumed.

FAT execution: Witness and, when required, execute FATs on electrical equipment and packaged systems. Confirm test setup, test equipment calibration, and acceptance criteria before testing starts.

Functional testing: Perform and verify point-to-point wiring checks, I/O and loop checks, control logic and sequence simulation, interlock and permissive testing, and alarm and trip verification.

Electrical tests: Witness and evaluate insulation resistance, hi-pot and dielectric withstand, CT/PT ratio and polarity, protective relay setting and trip tests, contact and winding resistance, transformer routine tests (turns ratio, impedance, losses), and partial discharge where specified.

Data review: Critically review test reports and data. Challenge results that pass but fall outside expected ranges or show poor trends.

Release for shipment: Issue FAT reports, punch lists, and release-for-shipment approvals. No equipment ships with open quality holds unless formally dispositioned.

Final documentation: Verify data books are complete: test records, calibration certificates, material certifications, as-built drawings, and listings (UL, CSA, CE) as applicable.

Nonconformance and Corrective Action

Issue and manage Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs). Lead root cause analysis with suppliers (8D, 5-Why, fishbone) and verify corrective actions are effective before closure.

Disposition supplier nonconformances with Engineering (use-as-is, rework, repair, reject). Track cost of poor quality and recover it from the supplier where applicable.

Support manufacturing, site, and commissioning teams on quality escapes traced to suppliers. Close the loop with the supplier to prevent recurrence.

Supplier Qualification, Audits, and Development

Perform pre-award capability assessments and supplier audits against ISO 9001 and PROENERGY Supplier Quality requirements.

Approve supplier First Article Inspections (FAI) and fixed process changes. Enforce supplier change control to engineering standards.

Maintain quarterly supplier scorecards (quality, on-time delivery, responsiveness) for the Supplier List. Drive improvement plans for underperforming suppliers.

Establish, monitor, and report supplier quality KPIs to Engineering, Supply Chain, and leadership.

Evaluate and qualify new suppliers, materials, and components with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the electrical quality technical interface between suppliers, Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Commissioning.

Interpret one-line and three-line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, and specifications with supplier technical teams.

Support receiving inspection and integration of purchased electrical components into in-house controls fabrication and package assembly.

Manage implementation of specification and design changes at suppliers.

Serve as a member of the Internal Audit Team and support continuous improvement of the Supplier Quality System.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology. An equivalent combination of technical training and 8+ years of directly relevant hands-on experience will be considered.

5+ years in supplier quality, source inspection, electrical testing, or QA/QC for power , utility, oil and gas, or heavy industrial electrical equipment.

Demonstrated experience witnessing or performing FATs on switchgear, transformers, generators, or control systems.

Hands-on proficiency with electrical test equipment: insulation resistance testers, hi-pot sets, relay test sets, transformer turns ratio (TTR) testers, micro-ohmmeters, and multimeters.

Ability to read and interpret one-line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, and control logic.

Working knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

Working knowledge of NFPA 70E electrical safety practices.

Ability to travel domestically and internationally 50% to 75%.

Must be fluent in English, with strong speaking, reading, writing, and comprehension skills

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa.

Candidate must also pass a State and Federal criminal history/security background check and pre-employment drug screen.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with aeroderivative or industrial gas turbine packages or power plant balance of plant equipment.

Knowledge of IEEE C37 (switchgear), IEEE C57 (transformers), IEEE 115 (synchronous machines), NEMA, UL 508A, IEC 61439, and ANSI/NETA ATS.

FAT experience on PLC, DCS, or turbine control systems, including Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, FactoryTalk).

NETA Level III or IV, NICET, or API SIEE (Source Inspector Electrical Equipment) certification.

ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher; working use of FMEA, control plans, and 8D.

Experience with ERP and quality management systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and MS Office Suite.

Key Performance Measures

ITPs approved before start of manufacturing on all critical-path electrical equipment.

Attendance at all designated FAT witness and hold points.

Supplier quality escapes reaching PROENERGY receiving, site, or commissioning, trending down.

NCR and SCAR closure cycle time.

On-time delivery performance for assigned suppliers.

Supplier review cadence held as scheduled; scorecards issued on time each quarter.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

Work is performed in supplier factories, test bays, and manufacturing floors, as well as office settings.

Exposure to energized equipment during testing. Must follow NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout procedures, and wear required PPE, including arc-rated PPE where applicable.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Kairologix

Kairologix is a Forward Deployed Engineering company. We put AI to work inside our clients businesses. We make their data AI ready, connect their systems into one company context, and build AI agents and workflows for HR, finance, sales, support and operations. We build on the AI platforms clients already own, run what we build until it delivers results, then hand it over.

The role

You will be our first engineer, and you will work on both sides of a client engagement. Before the deal, you work as a Solutions Engineer: you join sales conversations with prospects and our platform partners, understand the client's problem, and show what is possible with a working demo. Once the client signs, you work as a Forward Deployed Engineer: you sit with their teams and ship the solution in weeks, not months.

Before the deal: solutions engineering

  • Join sales conversations and lead the technical discussion
  • Run discovery on the client's process, systems and data
  • Build quick demos and proofs of concept on the client's own use case
  • Design the solution, estimate the effort and write the technical part of proposals
  • Answer technical, data and security questions from client IT teams

After the deal: forward deployed engineering

  • Sit with client teams and map how their work really happens
  • Find, clean, structure and label messy data from HR, finance, CRM and delivery systems
  • Build data pipelines and integrations using APIs, databases, SFTP feeds and file drops
  • Build AI agents and automated workflows that people use every day, and test them for accuracy and safety
  • Run what you build, improve it against agreed outcomes, and hand it over with clear documentation

What you will bring

  • 3 to 5 years of hands-on engineering experience
  • Strong SQL and Python
  • Real experience building data pipelines and connecting business systems such as HRMS, ERP, CRM, SharePoint or Jira
  • At least one AI agent or LLM workflow you built that real users used
  • Comfort working from vague problems, without a detailed spec
  • Confidence in front of clients: you can run a discovery call, present a demo, and explain a solution to an HR head or a CFO in plain words

Good to have

  • IT services or consulting experience, followed by time at a startup
  • Experience as a solutions engineer, pre-sales engineer, implementation engineer or forward deployed engineer
  • Hands-on experience with any major AI agent or automation platform
  • Experience as an early employee or founder

What we offer

  • A founding team role with real ownership
  • Equity in Kairologix, vesting over time
  • Direct work with a founder who has built and sold a company before
  • Exposure to many industries, problems and AI platforms

Apply at careers.kairologix.io

title: Research Associate
description:
Applications are invited for a postdoctoral research associate position to study neural mechanisms of visual learning in mice in the laboratories of Professor Ole Paulsen and Dr Jasper Poort (both Department of Physiology, Development and Neuroscience), at the University of Cambridge.

The project combines anatomical tracing, electrophysiology, two-photon imaging, and optogenetic manipulation of different cell types and neural projections to understand how mice learn to become experts in reward-based visually-guided decision-making tasks and the role of inhibitory interneurons. The successful applicant will join a supportive and multi-disciplinary collaborative research environment.

Applicants will have completed (or be about to complete) a PhD in neuroscience, biology, or other relevant disciplines. We are looking for someone with expertise in behavioural training, electrophysiology and data analysis (e.g. Matlab or Python) and experience with stereotaxic surgery in mice.

For more information about the labs see [https://noggin.pdn.cam.ac.uk/](https://noggin.pdn.cam.ac.uk/) and [https://www.pdn.cam.ac.uk/svl/](https://www.pdn.cam.ac.uk/svl/). Informal enquiries about the position can be made to Ole Paulsen ( [op210@cam.ac.uk](mailto:op210@cam.ac.uk) ) and/or Dr Jasper Poort ( [jp816@cam.ac.uk](mailto:jp816@cam.ac.uk)).

Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available until 30 September 2027 in the first instance.

Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will be appointed at Research Assistant level, which will be amended to Research Associate once their PhD has been awarded.

Salary Scales are: Research Assistant: £33,662 - £36,320, Research Associate: £38,448 - £46,970.

Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online.

To apply for this post, please submit a CV, cover letter, and 1 page research proposal on 'circuit mechanisms of visually-guided decision-making using patch-clamp electrophysiology'. We also need the contact details of two people who can provide a professional reference.

Job Overview

The Senior Planner is responsible for ensuring the availability of materials, components, and finished goods at the required time, quantity, and location to support production schedules and customer commitments. This role leads end-to-end planning activities across demand, supply, inventory, subcontract manufacturing, and global warehouse operations, while balancing service levels, inventory investment, operational costs, capacity constraints, and supply chain risks.

The position serves as a key cross-functional partner to Procurement, Operations, Finance, Engineering, and external manufacturing partners, driving planning excellence and supply continuity across the organization.


Key Responsibilities

Material & Supply Planning

  • Develop and manage material and supply plans aligned with forecasts, customer demand, and production requirements.
  • Analyze material requirements and identify supply constraints, shortages, and potential bottlenecks.
  • Manage short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons to ensure material readiness.

Contract Manufacturer & Supplier Management

Inventory & Warehouse Management

  • Define and maintain inventory targets to support business objectives.

  • Conduct inventory analysis and implement actions to optimize inventory accuracy, availability, and cost.
  • Balance inventory investment with customer service and operational requirements.

  • Maintain visibility of material status, inventory position, open purchase orders, and expected deliveries.
  • Develop and track planning KPIs, reports, and performance dashboards.
  • Analyze trends, identify risks, and provide actionable recommendations to management.
  • Support executive decision-making through data-driven insights.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in planning processes, inventory policies, and operational workflows.

  • Support automation initiatives and reporting enhancements in collaboration with Information Systems teams.
  • Champion process standardization and supply chain best practices.

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree is an advantage.
  • 3+ years of experience in Material Planning, Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Procurement, or Supply Chain Planning.
  • Experience participating in S&OP processes within a global organization.
  • Experience working with Contract Manufacturers (CM) and/or EMS partners in a global environment.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing, procurement, logistics, inventory management, and supply chain planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Priority, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with advanced Excel skills.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

Requirements

Manages all activities associated with biomedical &/or social-behavioral research studies considered very complex by the inclusion of several of the following: multiple investigators, teams, sites, sub-contracts, participants, longitudinal assessments/ interventions; &/or multi-million-dollar budgets. Ensures completion of contract requirements & client specifications.  Oversees day-to-day operations including identifying & securing needed resources; creating, implementing, monitoring, & updating project plans; facilitating meetings with appropriate parties; tracking tasks/deliverables to ensure timelines, milestones &/or goals are attained; monitoring & reporting progress as appropriate; & resolving or escalating issues in a timely manner.   May co-author scientific papers for presentation & publication & coordinates writing, submission & administration of grants.  Ensures that all study activities are completed by strictly following Good Clinical Practices (GCP) & all current local, state, & federal laws, regulations, guidance, policy & procedure developed by the NU Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food & Drug Administration (FDA) Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), & the International Conference on Harmonization (ICH).

_Project Description: Implementation Science Coordination Initiative Supplement_

The Implementation Science Coordination Initiative (ISCI) is an NIH-funded national Coordination, Consultation, and Data Management Center based at Northwestern University’s Impact Institute. ISCI supports dissemination and implementation science (D&IS) in HIV by coordinating data harmonization, supporting shared measures and cross-site learning, synthesizing HIV-specific D&IS knowledge, and disseminating practical tools and resources for researchers, practitioners, community partners, and federal partners. ISCI’s work is grounded in the Ending the HIV Epidemic initiative and focuses on creating generalizable knowledge that can help effective HIV prevention and care interventions reach real-world service delivery settings.

(1)           Through the ISCI administrative supplement, Ryan White Clinic System Landscape, Innovation Implementation, and Network for Knowledge (RW-LINK), ISCI will extend its coordination and data infrastructure to better characterize Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program (RWHAP)-funded organizations, including services provided, implementation capacity and readiness, service and research priorities, and interest in participating in research. RW-LINK will support development of a national survey, integration of survey findings into ISCI data systems, dissemination of findings through reports and dashboards, and development of resources to help researchers align multisite HIV D&IS studies with clinic-identified priorities and engagement needs.

(2)           This Research Project Manager position will support research and administrative activities across both ISCI’s core coordination center and the RW-LINK supplement. Responsibilities will include coordinating project plans, timelines, meetings, and deliverables; supporting communication and collaboration with investigators, staff, federal partners, researchers, service providers, and other stakeholders; overseeing study records, data collection, and integration of findings into ISCI data systems; supporting development and dissemination of reports, dashboards, tools, and other project products; monitoring project expenses and administrative requirements; and supervising or coordinating staff completing related project activities.

_Program Description: Impact Institute_

This subset of projects is housed within the Impact Institute at Northwestern University (https://impact-institute.northwestern.edu/). The Impact Institute currently has multiple NIH- and foundation-funded studies and actively collaborates with community-based organizations to conduct research on the health of LGBTQ populations and translate findings into interventions. It is co-directed by Dr. Brian Mustanski and Dr. Kathryn Macapagal.

_Please note:_

Supervisor provides objectives and deadlines.  Work is reviewed for fulfillment of objective and deadlines and overall compliance with policy and procedures.  EE completes some activities without direction, informing supervisor only of potentially controversial matters, and/or far-reaching implications.

**Specific Responsibilities**:

_Technical_

- Provides complex scientific & technical leadership in determining research priorities & the plan, design & execution of research projects ensuring that programs of investigation meet specified objectives.
- Plans, develops & implements new processes & protocols to support research studies & maximize/extend study capabilities.
- Oversees completion of study activities per protocol.
- Ensures that study protocols are in compliance with appropriate rules & regulations & reviews study progress and recommends revisions, amendments, and/or other study changes as necessary to better meet needs of sponsors.
- Reviews scientific literature & evaluates & recommends applicable techniques & procedures.

_Administrative_

- Analyzes, evaluates & interprets data to determine relevance to research.
- Assists PI in developing statistical methods & models to analyze & report data based upon study requirements.
- Prepares results & may co-author scientific papers for presentation & publication & disseminates information via seminars, lectures, etc.
- Creates data for use in grant submission & develop new proposals for research including obtaining financial support.
- Acts as liaison between sponsoring agencies, collaborating organizations &/or other research &/or educational institutions.
- Ensures that all study documents associated with current local, state, & federal regulatory guidelines, requirements, laws & research protocols are completed in a timely manner.

_Finance_

- May create &/or manage research study budget which may include deciding on & approving expenditures of funds based on budget.
- Monitors accounts.
- Negotiates prices & specifications with vendors.
- Purchases supplies, materials, equipment & services.
- Ensures appropriate allocation & compliance.
- Invoices study sponsors for study tests/procedures.
- Coordinates & participates in budgetary negotiations with industry sponsors.

_Supervision_

- Supervises research study assistants and coordinators supporting projects led by the Research Project Manager.
- Trains, directs, assigns duties to & may supervise lab EEs, students, residents &/or fellows.
- Acts as a mentor in regard to education of junior coordinators.

_Miscellaneous_

Performs other duties as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Administration, or a related field,

- Five years of experience working in public health, implementation, quality improvement, and/or program evaluation research.

- Three years of experience leading and organizing training programs, including curriculum development, facilitation, and administrative coordination.

- Experience coordinating and writing research manuscripts

- Prior work conducting systematic reviews, literature reviews, etc.

- Experience with qualitative research and/or interviewing.

- Experiencing supervising research assistants and interns.

- Prior work coordinating activities for multi-site research projects.

- Familiarity with data management software, including REDCap.

Naszą misją jest dbałość o niezawodną i efektywną pracę systemu elektroenergetycznego w Polsce oraz jego stały rozwój. Jesteśmy jednostką do innowacyjnych zadań specjalnych w branży elektroenergetycznej.

Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za tworzenie systemów i aplikacji w obszarze zarządzania modelem KSE.

title: Senior Associate Director Donor Relations
description:
**Department:** Law Development

**Salary/Grade:** EXS/10

_Target hiring range for this position will be between $87,900.00 - $103,367.00 per year.  Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data._

**Job Summary:**

Under the direction of the Executive Director of Alumni Engagement and Constituent Relations, the Senior Associate Director is responsible for a variety of activities designed to acknowledge Northwestern Pritzker School of Law donors and maintain a robust stewardship program within the Department of Law Alumni Relations and Development. The primary functions of the role include overseeing the acknowledgement process and drafting high-level, decanal and associate dean correspondence; managing all student-related stewardship activities, including scholarship matching; student prize administration and fund reporting; developing and implementing strategies for annual fund stewardship; and providing event support for all stewardship events, as well as managing the program assistant of donor relations. The Associate Director will also assist with drafting content for publications and assist with other related programming as necessary and act as the lead stewardship writer for the team.

Northwestern Pritzker Law prides itself on its active and diverse community, which brings together a passionate and talented group of students, staff, and faculty. The Law School endeavors to take principled action towards ensuring that we live up to our responsibility—and our institutional values—to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive community for all constituents. Law School leadership commits to working tirelessly to ensure every member feels valued, all students can study and train to be successful in their careers, all staff members can develop personally and professionally, and where our faculty can both teach and support our students and produce top quality research and scholarship.

_Please note:_ Ability to work occasional nights and weekends as needed for events.

**Specific Responsibilities**:

_Strategic Planning_

- Gathers data and develops strategies designed to realize the current and life-time giving potential of individual prospects.
- Maintain consistent and appropriate contact with donors and ensures effective stewardship.

_Collaboration_

- Involves moderate- to-high-level of collaboration with both internal department partners and moderate level of collaboration with broader University partners to identify & integrate resources in order to accomplish strategic goals & objectives, including but not limited to:
  - Coordinate with Admissions, Financial Aid and Finance, to organize scholarship matching each fall (ensuring that any donor preferences are accounted for), notify students of their named scholarship, distribute surveys, and collects thank you letters from scholarship recipients, coordinate photos of all scholarship recipients, and work with gift officers to set up any visits or meetings with scholarship students and donors.
  - Oversee student prize awards, work with faculty and Human Resources, ensure that students are notified of award and paid in a timely manner.
  - Develop and implement stewardship strategies for annual fund donors throughout the fiscal year in coordination with annual fund team.
  - Benchmark with University partners to determine stewardship best practices.

_Prospects & Gifts_

- Develop stewardship strategies, goals and approaches for more complex, key, or high-profile groups of donors and work with other areas of development to implement donor strategies that will maximize dollars raised and participation of donors.
- Works with other areas of development to coordinate contacts.

_Reunion_

- Recruit and coordinate with reunion volunteers and lead team efforts to recognize reunion volunteers and reunion-related gifts.

_Events_

- Create donor centric event materials, including programs and other collateral materials.
- Responsible for an annual “Student Support Event” (luncheon or reception in the spring with scholarship recipients and donors) ensuring donors are engaged with their matched students.
- Provide support for stewardship events, such as post-lecture dinners, dedication events, chair ceremonies, leadership donor events, etc. in coordination with other team members.

_Volunteer and Engagement Stewardship_

- Develop and manage a formal stewardship strategy for alumni volunteers, including board members, mentors, and alumni leaders.
- Create systems to track engagement and recognize volunteer contributions.
- Identify opportunities to deepen relationships with highly engaged alumni and connect them to future philanthropic opportunities.

_Long-Form Stewardship and Donor Communications_

- Lead the development of compelling, narrative driven stewardship pieces that demonstrate the impact of philanthropy.
- Identify stories and information across Northwestern and translate them into meaningful donor communications.
- Partner across departments to ensure stewardship content supports donor retention, cultivation, and fundraising priorities

_Administration_

- Oversee gift acknowledgment process ensuring acknowledgements are sent in a timely manner and with the appropriate personalization, in coordination with Program Assistant.
- Prepare, draft, and distribute high-level stewardship correspondence and donor recognition content such as gift acknowledgments and announcements, stewardship emails, donor relations-related web-content, etc.
- Create annual impact reports for annual fund donors of $10K+ or more.
- Obtain information for and draft stewardship reports to individual donors of endowed funds.
- Lead all student-related stewardship efforts, including fund reports for summer fellowships, student prizes, and scholarships.
- Work in coordination with Sr. Associate Director, major gift officers, Northwestern’s Gift Acceptance and Fund Management, Gift and Record Services, and the Law School’s Finance team, to assist with the creation and use of gift of endowed and expendable funds consistent with donor intent.
- Review utilization of databases and recommend changes to create efficient systems for prompts and tracking to ensure timely and appropriate activity and records.
- Responsible for ordering, maintaining, and tracking distribution of donor recognition items.

_Supervisory_

- Manage Donor Relations Program Assistant
  - Manage donor acknowledgment process, including overseeing acknowledgments, monitoring workflows, and ensuring timely and accurate donor communications.
  - Oversee program operations and administrative support, including tracking projects, maintaining records, and managing deadlines and deliverables.
  - Manage and oversee reporting, events, and special projects the PA is assigned, to ensure strengthened relationships with donors and priorities are advanced.

_Miscellaneous_

Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree; OR appropriate combination of education and experience.

- 4 years development, marketing, sales or the equivalent experience is required.


**Minimum Competencies: (Skills, knowledge, and abilities.)**

- A sense of humor and a collaborative spirit.

- Excellent written communication skills

- Strong verbal communication skills

- Very strong project management experience

- Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, email, and database software programs

- Ability to work very well with a wide range of internal and external constituents

- Ability to maintain strict confidentiality


**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience with stewardship and donor relations

- Development experience at an institution of higher education

- Experience with event planning


**Preferred Competencies: (Skills, knowledge, and abilities)**

- An aptitude for reporting and analysis, especially related to fundraising campaign and giving reports

_**Benefits:**_

_At Northwestern, we are proud to provide meaningful and competitive benefits. The available benefits package for this position will include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid vacation and holidays; paid medical/sick and parentalleave;tuition benefits for the employee and dependents; pre-tax and flex spending accounts for commuting and dependent care; generous retirement savings options; and wellness programs. For a comprehensive overview of available benefits, including eligibility details, visit us at https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/benefits/index.html to learn more._

_Northwestern supports employee career development in all circumstances whether your workspace is on campus or at home. If you’re interested in developing your professional potential or continuing your formal education, we offer a variety of tools and resources. Visit us at_[_https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/learning/index.html_](https://www.northwestern.edu/hr/learning/index.html) _to learn more_ _**.**_
